paper.title: Where Reasoning Diverges: Localized Multi-Agent Debate
paper.abstract: Abstract: Multi-agent debate commonly exchanges complete reasoning traces even when disagreements concern only a few intermediate claims. We introduce Localized Multi-Agent Debate (LMAD), an inference-time protocol that represents agent traces as typed nodes, locates their earliest conflict, and restricts debate to the corresponding local segments. Guarded resolution extends a shared committed state so that later conflicts can be addressed without reopening accepted steps. We evaluate a single fixed LMAD configuration on four multi-hop question-answering benchmarks using ten backbones from four model families. Our method achieves the highest macro-averaged judge accuracy across all ten backbones, outperforming the strongest conventional baseline by up to 7.20 percentage points.

summary.oneLiner: LMAD将多智能体辩论从整段推理交换改为定位最早冲突、仅辩论局部片段，并通过带证据守卫的提交状态修复多跳问答推理。
summary.motivation: 现有多智能体辩论通常交换完整推理链，但分歧往往只集中在少数中间论断；在多跳问答中，智能体可能在早期事实上一致，却在后续跳步选错实体或关系，首个分歧会沿链传播并导致不同最终答案，而答案级投票无法揭示分歧起点，迫使智能体在大量已一致步骤上重复争论。
summary.method: 提出推理时协议LMAD：各智能体在共享已提交状态P上生成自由形式推理并保留原答案；抽取器E将推理映射为有序原子节点链Z_i；若归一化答案不一致，定位器L自链首扫描，返回最早跨智能体语义冲突δ及每个智能体的见证索引t_i，仅辩论以该节点为结尾的前缀片段S_i；各智能体在R轮局部辩论中辩护或修订见证论断，零温度解析器Φ汇总为替换节点b_Z及逐字引证b_Q；提交守卫仅在问题主体/关系不变且引证逐字出现在上下文时，将b_Z追加到P；已提交节点不再重开，智能体从更新状态继续推理并重复定位—辩论—提交，直至答案一致、守卫拒绝、或达迭代上限；失败时回退多数投票。固定配置：3个同骨干异温度智能体(0.1/0.5/0.9)，每迭代1轮局部辩论，最多10次迭代，辅助模块(抽取、定位、解析)均用temperature=0。
summary.experimentSetup: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue、StrategyQA四个多跳/策略问答基准上，用Qwen2.5(7B/14B/32B)、Qwen3(8B/14B/32B)、Qwen3.5(4B/9B)、Gemma3(4B/12B)共10个开源骨干，对比CoT、三样本自洽(SC)、Consensus、标准MAD与dMAD；所有多智能体方法均用3个智能体且骨干固定。主指标为Qwen2.5-32B判定器在确定性解码下的语义正确率，四数据集宏平均等权。实现基于vLLM，4×NVIDIA A100 80GB，总计算约60 GPU-hours；Qwen3/Qwen3.5关闭显式thinking模式；各例使用完整给定上下文(含干扰段落或StrategyQA事实)。
results: 10个骨干的四数据集宏平均判定准确率均为LMAD最高，相对各骨干最强常规基线提升1.30–6.50个百分点，平均提升2.94个百分点
40个骨干×数据集组合中，LMAD在36项优于最强基线、1项持平、3项落后
MuSiQue上提升最一致且最大：全部骨干均优于最强基线，最大单点提升7.20个百分点(Qwen2.5-7B)
Qwen2.5-7B宏平均：LMAD 73.05% vs 最强基线68.00%(Consensus)，Δ=+5.05% [95% CI: +3.50, +6.60]
提交策略消融(仅含STRICT曾拒绝修复的样本)：STRICT宏平均55.98%，CONCRETE 49.42%，ALWAYS 48.42%，STRICT分别高6.56与7.56个百分点
summary.trainingResources: 无模型训练，LMAD为纯推理时协议。论文披露：vLLM实现，4×NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU，总计算约60 GPU-hours；同一骨干同时用于求解与节点抽取、冲突定位、解析等辅助模块。
limitations: 当前将推理表示为有序中间状态链，而真实推理可能具有更丰富的非线性结构
尚未扩展到树状或图结构(如有向无环图)以刻画分支假设、汇聚证据与非线性依赖
summary.significance: 将多智能体辩论重新表述为“冲突定位的状态修复”问题，表明辩论粒度应落在最早分歧及其局部推理片段，而非整段答案/推理交换；在跨模型族、参数规模与推理深度上稳定提升多跳问答表现，并能在初始2:1错误多数下通过局部辩论与守卫提交修复共享状态，说明精细化协调比答案级聚合更能纠正可传播的跳步错误。

paper.title: MAPLE-Guard: Memory-Aware Link Enforcement Against Memory-Link Poisoning in Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) increasingly rely on persistent private and shared memories for long-horizon coordination. This memory layer improves continuity, but it also gives attackers a durable channel: a poisoned memory can be written once, continuously retrieved in later tasks, promoted into shared memory, and reused by other agents. A single poisoned write can therefore steer many later decisions and contaminate agents that never saw the original attack, all while no malicious message crosses a visible communication edge at the moment of harm. Further, because existing safeguards mainly inspect prompts, actions, or communication edges, they can miss attacks whose content appears benign at write time but becomes harmful after retrieval. We introduce Memory-Aware Propagation and Link Enforcement Guard, MAPLE-Guard, a memory-link guard for memory-enabled MAS. MAPLE-Guard monitors the memory lifecycle and places gates at write, retrieval, promotion, and cross-agent reuse, so risky memories can be quarantined, unsafe retrievals filtered, and poisoned private memories blocked before they enter shared memory. In the main evaluation, MAPLE-Guard lowers attack success rate (ASR) from 38.2% to 0.9% on LongMemEval and from 34.7% to 0.2% on AppWorld; it also raises multi-agent defense success rate (MDSR) from 54.0% to 74.3% and from 42.5% to 99.8% on the same benchmarks. These results suggest that memory-aware link enforcement covers a gap left by prompt-level and topology-level defenses. Code is available at the link: https://github.com/xiong-wenjun/MAPLE-Guard.

summary.oneLiner: 提出面向多智能体持久记忆的MAPLE-Guard，在写入、检索、提升与跨智能体复用四个生命周期关卡实施记忆链链接强制，显著降低记忆链投毒攻击成功率并提升多智能体防御成功率。
summary.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统 increasingly 依赖私有与共享持久记忆以支持长程协作，但攻击者可在写入时植入表面无害、检索后才显现危害的毒化记忆；该记忆可被反复检索、提升至共享记忆并被其他智能体复用，从而在伤害发生当下无需经过可见通信边即可持续影响决策，且现有主要检查提示、动作或通信拓扑的防护难以覆盖此类记忆链投毒。
summary.method: MAPLE-Guard（Memory-Aware Propagation and Link Enforcement Guard）将防御对象从消息边转为记忆链事件，在写入、检索、私有到共享的提升、跨智能体复用四处设门控；从运行时记忆操作中提取三类守卫信号——来源信任（provenance trust）、内容风险（content risk）与效用（utility），并结合元数据（范围、谱系、污点状态、任务成败历史等）经单一固定风险模型做确定性、规则化评分与阈值决策，可隔离、过滤或阻断可疑记忆；全五组基准共用一套手工设定、未逐基准搜索的超参数配置，且评估侧毒化标签与守卫输入严格分离。
summary.experimentSetup: 在推理、长期记忆、工具使用与迁移场景下，于随机通信拓扑的多智能体系统中评估五组基准—攻击组合：MMLU-MINJA、LongMemEval-MemoryGraft、AppWorld-AgentPoison、InjectAgent-ToolAttack，以及 PromptInject/CSQA 迁移测试；骨干模型为 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 与 gemma-4-31B；对比无防御及 AgentSafe、AgentXposed、Challenger、G-Safeguard、GUARDIAN、INFA-Guard；报告轮次级 ASR@1/2/3 与 MDSR@1/2/3 等指标。
results: 主评估（摘要报告）：LongMemEval 上 ASR 由 38.2% 降至 0.9%，MDSR 由 54.0% 升至 74.3%；AppWorld 上 ASR 由 34.7% 降至 0.2%，MDSR 由 42.5% 升至 99.8%。
无防御基线：MMLU-MINJA 上 ASR 达 51.4%；在 gemma-4-31B 上 MMLU 与 InjectAgent 攻击 ASR 均超过 75%；AppWorld 上 MDSR 可低至 42.5%。
LongMemEval-MemoryGraft（gemma-4-31B，第3轮）：无防御 ASR@3=69.6%、MDSR@3=25.6%；MAPLE-Guard ASR@3=0.7%、MDSR@3=35.6%。
AppWorld-AgentPoison（gemma-4-31B，第3轮）：无防御 ASR@3=40.2%、MDSR@3=57.5%；MAPLE-Guard ASR@3=1.3%、MDSR@3=93.0%。
MMLU-MINJA（gemma-4-31B，第3轮）：无防御 ASR@3=71.2%；MAPLE-Guard 将 ASR@3 降至 1.1%，但 MDSR@3 为 50.9%（低于部分拓扑/提示级基线）。
InjectAgent-ToolAttack（gemma-4-31B，第3轮）：无防御 ASR@3=87.0%、MDSR@3=16.0%；MAPLE-Guard ASR@3=62.0%、MDSR@3=32.0%，仍显著弱于 Qwen 骨干及多数其他基准上的防御效果。
Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 上 MAPLE-Guard 在 MMLU-MINJA、LongMemEval、AppWorld、InjectAgent 多数设置中将 ASR@3 压至 0.1%–5.1%，并在 AppWorld 上达到 MDSR@3=98.9%、ASR@3=0.0%。
summary.trainingResources: 论文未披露 GPU 数量、训练时长或专用模型训练细节；方法为固定规则与阈值的风险模型，非学习型分类器，未进行逐基准/逐攻击/逐骨干的超参搜索；实验依赖现成骨干 LLM（Qwen3.5-122B-A10B、gemma-4-31B）及公开基准与攻击适配。
limitations: 评估假设运行时元数据（来源路由、写入者、范围、谱系等）可信，未覆盖攻击者伪造元数据或谱系记录的场景。
守卫信号为确定性规则与手工阈值，对 write-time 看似无害、retrieve-time 才显危害的内容检测能力仍受固定风险模型表达能力限制。
在 InjectAgent-ToolAttack + gemma-4-31B 等设置下 ASR 仍高达 54.0%–62.0%（第3轮），表明对强工具投毒与较弱骨干的组合防御不足。
部分设置下 MAPLE-Guard 的 MDSR 低于无防御或其他基线（如 gemma-4-31B 上 LongMemEval MDSR@3=35.6%），可能存在过度拦截或任务成功率 trade-off。
论文包含可能误导或有害的攻击示例，实际部署仍需与提示级、拓扑级防护协同。
summary.significance: 首次将多智能体持久记忆中的“记忆链”传播形式化为 memory-link poisoning，并证明在消息边之外对记忆生命周期设门控可填补现有 MAS 安全空白；在 LongMemEval 与 AppWorld 等主基准上将 ASR 降至约 1% 量级、显著提升 MDSR，表明记忆感知链接强制是持久化多智能体系统不可或缺的一层防御。

paper.title: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (almost) Everything
paper.abstract: Abstract: Native computer use offers a general interface for agents to operate almost any software available to people, but requires long-horizon state tracking, large-scale interactive experience, and learning from sparse yet verifiable outcomes. We introduce Qwen-CUA, a native computer-use agent with a 397B-A17B Qwen mixture-of-experts backbone. It observes only screenshots and acts through keyboard and mouse events, without DOM trees, accessibility metadata, or task-specific APIs. Its scaffold maintains up to 20 active screenshots and folds older visual history in fixed-size blocks to retain recent evidence while preserving reusable prompt prefixes. For training, we build a cloud rollout fleet with access to nearly 100,000 vCPUs and tens of thousands of concurrent environments, construct approximately 40,000 verifiable tasks, and collect personalized long-horizon workflows across everyday and professional software. We optimize complete trajectories with verifiable rewards and trajectory slicing, while iterative training runs refresh supervised data and recalibrate reinforcement-learning tasks. Across eight benchmarks, Qwen-CUA outperforms Qwen3.7 and remains competitive with leading proprietary systems, reaching 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified and 18.5/48.4 binary/partial completion on OSWorld 2.0. Scaling the same recipe to a model with over one trillion parameters yields Qwen-CUA-Max, improving these scores to 87.6 and 21.2/53.3. Qwen-CUA also reduces RedTeamCUA attack success from 36.6 to 16.4 relative to Qwen3.7. Efficiency analyses, a browser deployment, and Bash-augmented experiments further characterize practical behavior. These results establish native computer use as a broadly capable agent foundation and highlight scalable verifiable interaction and hybrid tool use as key directions.

summary.oneLiner: Qwen-CUA 是基于 397B-A17B Qwen MoE 的纯截图原生键鼠计算机使用智能体，通过大规模可验证交互训练与长程视觉上下文管理，在八项基准上全面超越 Qwen3.7 并与领先闭源系统竞争。
summary.motivation: 大量数字工作（桌面应用、遗留系统、动态网站、专业工具、个性化工作流）只能通过图形界面完成，而现有基础模型主要擅长代码与 API。原生计算机使用以与人相同的像素感知与键鼠操作打通这一缺口，但面临 GUI 部分可观测、像素级动作定位、长程错误累积、监督信号稀疏且仅终态可验证等独特挑战，需要扩展环境规模、可验证任务、rollout 吞吐，以及从长多模态轨迹中学习。
summary.method: 提出 Qwen-CUA：仅接收截图、输出键鼠事件，不使用 DOM、无障碍树、Shell 或任务专用 API。智能体脚手架保留最多 20 张活跃截图，超出预算时以 10 张为块折叠更早视觉历史为固定文本占位符，保留近期像素与全部动作/推理以稳定 prompt 前缀并利于 KV-cache 复用；RL 训练采用相同折叠算子做轨迹切片，各切片继承终局奖励。在阿里云 ECS 上构建 rollout 舰队（近 10 万 vCPU、数万个并发环境），合成约 4 万可验证任务（含阶段状态链式长程工作流），并采集个性化桌面与专业软件的人类轨迹；以可执行结果奖励、SAPO 稳定长序列更新，迭代刷新 SFT 数据并重校准 RL 任务分布。同配方扩展至超 1T 参数得 Qwen-CUA-Max。
summary.experimentSetup: 在八项计算机使用基准上评估：OSWorld-Verified（360 任务、100 步上限、纯截图键鼠）、OSWorld 2.0（二元/部分完成率）、MyPCBench、ScienceBoard、Gym-Anything、WebArena、RedTeamCUA（攻击下良性任务成功率）、MacAgentBench。对比 Qwen3.7（非 thinking）、GPT-5.5（xhigh reasoning）、Claude Opus 4.8（max inference）及官方报告分数。另做效率分析、内部 Chrome 扩展部署展示，以及在 MyPCBench 上对比纯计算机使用 vs 计算机使用+Bash 混合设置。
results: OSWorld-Verified：Qwen-CUA 86.2%（359/360 任务有完整记录），Qwen-CUA-Max 87.6%；Qwen3.7 73.3%，GPT-5.5 78.7%，Claude Opus 4.8 83.4%
OSWorld 2.0：Qwen-CUA 二元 18.5% / 部分 48.4%；Qwen-CUA-Max 21.2% / 53.3%
RedTeamCUA：相对 Qwen3.7，攻击成功率从 36.6% 降至 16.4%；良性任务成功率 Qwen-CUA 74.0%
MyPCBench 完美任务率：Qwen-CUA 58.7%（Qwen3.7 51.6%，GPT-5.5 62.0%）
ScienceBoard：Qwen-CUA 64.50%；Gym-Anything 平均 46.3%；WebArena 64.16%；MacAgentBench Pass@1 69.2%
OSWorld-Verified 效率：平均 14.2 外步、18.8 动作、3605.8 输出 token/任务；OSWorld 2.0 平均 218.9 外步、248.2 动作
MyPCBench+Bash：Qwen-CUA 平均步数 63.6→49.1，但完美任务率 58.7%→55.1%，显示模态切换策略尚未成熟
八项基准任务指标均优于 Qwen3.7，与领先闭源系统保持竞争力
summary.trainingResources: 论文披露：397B-A17B Qwen MoE 骨干（Qwen-CUA-Max 超 1T 总参数）；阿里云 ECS rollout 舰队近 10 万 vCPU、数万个并发环境；约 4 万可验证任务及个性化长程工作流数据；迭代 SFT+RL（SAPO、轨迹切片、CUA-Gym 式可验证奖励）。GPU 数量、总 GPU 小时、预训练/后训练算力预算：论文未披露。
limitations: 标准化评测未覆盖的能力边界：陌生布局、动态网站状态、交互失败恢复、需用户介入的场景
长程 OSWorld 2.0 二元完成率仍低（18.5%），长时域端到端成功仍是难点
混合 Bash 可缩短轨迹（63.6→49.1 步）但会降低任务完成率（58.7%→55.1%），模型尚未学会何时切换命令行与图形界面
纯截图键鼠接口虽通用，但对高分辨率密集界面 grounding 与部分可观测状态跟踪仍具固有难度
consequential 操作依赖用户确认机制，完全自主高风险场景能力与安全边界仍需进一步验证
summary.significance: 证明原生截图键鼠计算机使用可作为 broadly capable 的智能体基础能力；规模化可验证交互基础设施（近 10 万 vCPU、4 万任务）与迭代 SFT+RL 配方可系统提升长程 GUI 智能体；块折叠视觉上下文管理在训练推理对齐下兼顾长程记忆与效率；RedTeamCUA 攻击成功率显著下降表明能力与安全可协同改进；混合原生交互与 Bash 等专用工具被定位为提升效率与覆盖面的关键方向。

paper.title: ReTouch: Empowering Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation with Online-Refined Tactile Prediction
paper.abstract: Abstract: Fusing tactile signals has proven effective for contact-rich manipulation, enabling robots to perceive contact states and adapt to rapidly changing physical interactions. Yet effectively integrating tactile feedback into dexterous manipulation remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce ReTouch, a vision-language-action model (VLA) that supports contact-rich dexterous manipulation through tactile predictions continually refined online using execution-time feedback. ReTouch builds on two main innovations for tactile representation and closed-loop action generation. First, its Tactile-Patch Encoder represents tactile observations as structured tactile patch features that preserve finger identity and local contact structure, providing contact cues for fine-grained dexterous control. Second, its high-frequency action module jointly predicts future tactile states and action chunks and refines both using incoming tactile feedback during execution. This closed-loop refinement keeps tactile predictions aligned with evolving physical interactions, enabling responsive action correction and improving robustness to contact changes and execution errors. We further introduce XHT-Dataset, comprising 900 real-world demonstrations across seven contact-rich tasks collected on an XHand--UR7e platform, and evaluate ReTouch through closed-loop real-robot experiments. ReTouch surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.4 and 23.8 percentage points in average success rate under standard and challenging conditions, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.

explanation: abstract keywords action model, manipulation, vision language action, vision-language-action, vla (+5)

summary.oneLiner: ReTouch 是一种面向接触丰富灵巧操作的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过 Tactile-Patch 编码保留指级接触结构，并在执行过程中用实时触觉反馈在线递归 refine 未来触觉预测与动作块。
summary.motivation: 接触丰富的多指灵巧操作需要持续感知哪些手指接触、是否滑移及多指接触是否稳定；纯视觉 VLA 难以可靠推断接触位置、力与抓取稳定性。现有触觉方法常将触觉信号展平或压缩为通用 token，丢失指级空间结构，难以将局部接触变化映射到细粒度指端调整；同时接触状态会因滑移、接触位移与执行误差快速变化，动作块起始时刻生成的未来触觉预测在执行中易过时，而多数方法未在块内持续用最新触觉反馈更新该预测。
summary.method: ReTouch 基于预训练 π₀ 初始化，输入包括三视角 RGB（224×224）、语言指令、18 维本体状态（UR7e 六关节 + XHand 十二关节）及 10 帧触觉历史（5 指 × 120 taxel × 3 轴）。Tactile-Patch Encoder 将原始触觉组织为保留指身份与局部接触结构的 patch 特征（拇指 T30、其余四指 T16 固定 taxel-to-patch 映射），经时空聚合形成 token。训练时用 Hindsight Action Expert（HAE，18 层 Transformer，hidden 1024，8 头）处理真实未来触觉 patch 生成动作相关目标 latent；Foresight Action Expert（FAE，同架构）从当前观测预测未来触觉 latent，并在第 12 层用 cosine 对齐（权重 0.1）。FAE 作为高频动作模块与 VLM 异步运行，联合预测 16 步动作块与未来触觉状态；执行时在 offset 4、8、12 用最新触觉递归 refine 未来 tactile latent 并重生成剩余动作后缀（blocking refinement）。动作生成采用 flow matching，推理为 10 步 Euler 积分。
summary.experimentSetup: 在 XHand–UR7e 真实平台构建 XHT-Dataset：900 条成功示教、7 项接触丰富任务（移液管按压、瓶抓取、玉米抓取、海绵擦拭、按钮按压、柜门取物、液体转移），800 条训练、100 条离线 held-out；ReTouch 与 Tactile-VLA、π 系列跨七任务联合训练，RDP 与 ViTacFormer 为任务特定训练。每项任务 20 次真实机器人 rollout，前 5 项超时 60 s、后 2 项 120 s，采用分阶段归一化评分。标准设置对比 RDP、ViTacFormer、π₀、π₀+tactile、π₀.5、π₀.5+tactile、Tactile-VLA；挑战设置含海绵擦拭高度变化、玉米抓取物体位置偏移、液体转移光照变化、瓶抓取下拉扰动及恢复。部署延迟在 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上测得（仅模型计算，不含通信与控制器开销）。
results: 标准设置七任务平均成功率：ReTouch 83.6%，最强基线 Tactile-VLA 65.2%，绝对提升 +18.4 个百分点；分项为 Pipette Press 86.0%、Bottle Grasp 95.0%、Cob Grasp 100.0%、Sponge Wipe 87.5%、Button Press 85.0%、Cabinet Retrieval 62.5%、Liquid Transfer 69.0%。

挑战/OOD 设置四项平均成功率：ReTouch 73.1%，最强基线 π₀.5+tactile 49.3%，绝对提升 +23.8 个百分点；分项为 Height Sponge 42.5%、Sponge Position Cob 66.5%、Cob Lighting Liquid 85.0%、Liquid Pull Bottle 98.5%（表头对应 Sponge Wipe 高度、Cob Grasp 位置、Liquid Transfer 光照、Bottle Grasp 拉拽扰动）。

离线诊断（100 条 held-out 轨迹，接触后阶段）：相对 one-shot 固定块首触觉预测，ReTouch 递归 refine 使未来 tactile latent 平均 cosine 相似度相对提升 +0.908%，动作后缀 MSE 相对降低 2.139%（offset 4/8/12 分别 +0.693%/+1.148%/+0.880% 与 +1.317%/+2.074%/+2.764%）。
部署推理延迟（RTX 5090，仅模型）：初始 VLM–FAE pass 52.25 ms，cached-context FAE refinement 19.54 ms；对应约 9 Hz 完整周期与 36 Hz FAE 更新。
summary.trainingResources: 论文披露：训练使用 8× NVIDIA A800 GPU、bfloat16 混合精度；Tactile-Patch Encoder 预训练全局 batch size 32，策略训练全局 batch size 8；AdamW、梯度裁剪 1.0、1000 step warmup、cosine 学习率从 2.5×10⁻⁵ 衰减至 2.5×10⁻⁶；Encoder 预训练对比实验为 20k updates。ReTouch 策略训练总 update 数论文未披露；同数据集 π 系列与 Tactile-VLA 基线为 80k updates、batch size 8。数据收集依赖 VIVE 腕部追踪、MANUS 手套遥操作及三 RGB 相机。
limitations: 论文未给出独立“局限”章节；方法依赖 XHand 固定 taxel-to-patch 映射与 18 维关节指令空间，跨手型/跨平台泛化未系统验证。
Full ReTouch 采用 blocking refinement：更新动作块时暂停执行末条命令，可能引入控制停顿；非 blocking 变体仅作消融。
XHT-Dataset 规模 900 条示教、七任务，评估限于单一真实机器人平台，未报告仿真或更大规模跨域结果。
部分困难任务绝对成功率仍有限（如标准设置 Cabinet Retrieval 62.5%、挑战设置 Height Sponge 42.5%），对复杂多阶段或长时程任务仍有提升空间。
summary.significance: ReTouch 将触觉从“当前状态融合”推进到“执行期在线 refine 的未来触觉预测 + 动作共生成”闭环，并以 Tactile-Patch Encoder 显式保留指级/contact 局部结构；配套 XHT-Dataset 与 XHand–UR7e 基准显示，在标准与挑战条件下相对最强基线分别提升 18.4 与 23.8 个百分点，为接触丰富灵巧 VLA 提供了可复现的数据、表征与高频闭环 refinement 范式。

paper.title: Latency-Tolerant Cloud-Edge Collaborative Vision-Language-Action Models via Emergent Representational Specialization
paper.abstract: Abstract: Deploying billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies on mobile robots creates a systems conflict: semantic reasoning benefits from cloud GPUs, whereas closed-loop control must respond locally despite network delay and jitter. Existing hierarchical and asynchronous policies improve throughput, but their slow-path representations can still arrive stale or require explicit scheduling and delay cues. We introduce CloudEdgeVLA, a cloud-edge policy that treats temporal misalignment as a representation-learning problem. A cloud VLA encodes delayed observations into slowly varying task features, while a lightweight edge head combines the latest available cloud feature with current local vision. During training, current and randomly delayed frames are paired with the same current action target in fresh and stale paths. This objective encourages the cloud representation to preserve task-level information while the edge path supplies state-sensitive corrections. Across four LIBERO suites, CloudEdgeVLA retains 63.8--78.0% success with a 40-step uniform-delay window, whereas VLASH reaches at most 6.4% and the evaluated single-path baselines at most 3.0%. By removing blocking synchronization from the control loop, the design offers a practical route to scalable VLA deployment in which cloud models can grow while edge computation remains lightweight and responsive.

summary.oneLiner: CloudEdgeVLA通过云端VLA编码延迟观测为慢变任务特征、边缘轻量头融合最新云特征与实时本地视觉，并以配对帧双路径训练实现无需阻塞同步的延迟鲁棒云边协同操控。
summary.motivation: 十亿级参数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略部署于移动机器人时存在系统冲突：语义推理受益于云端GPU，但闭环控制必须在网络延迟与抖动下本地快速响应。现有分层与异步策略虽提升吞吐，慢路径表征仍可能陈旧，或依赖显式调度与延迟提示；云边异步部署还要求跨网络传递的表征在未知、可变“年龄”下仍可用。
summary.method: 提出CloudEdgeVLA异步云边框架：云端LoRA适配的7B OpenVLA骨干（基于OpenVLA-OFT）将延迟观测与语言指令编码为规划特征h（System 2，慢变任务语义）；边缘冻结SigLIP-Base提取当前观测实时视觉z_t（System 1）；Vision-Augmented Action Head将最新可用（可能陈旧）的h与z_t融合，经残差MLP预测连续动作块。训练时对同一episode窗口内当前帧o_t与随机延迟帧o_{t-d}（d~Uniform(1,W-1)）分别前向得到h_fresh与h_stale，均与同一当前动作a_t监督，损失L=(1-λ)||â_fresh-a_t||_1+λ||â_stale-a_t||_1，λ经课程学习从0增至λ_max。推理时边缘永不阻塞等待云端，始终用最近收到的h配合当前z_t执行。
summary.experimentSetup: 仿真：LIBERO四套件（Spatial/Object/Goal/Long，各10任务、每任务50演示），对比OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、UniVLA、VLASH及CloudEdgeVLA；评估无延迟（d_max=0）与均匀延迟k~Uniform{1,…,d_max}（d_max∈{5,10,15,20,25,30,40}环境步），每任务50次试验；CloudEdgeVLA报告种子7/8/9均值±标准差。消融在d_max=10下检验边缘视觉、编码器规模与双路径损失。真机：Franka pick-and-place小样本可行性检验（静态与动态10cm目标位移），边缘RTX 5080运行视觉编码器、动作头与控制环，7B骨干由RTX 4090云端服务；在原生系统延迟之上叠加0/400/1000 ms RTT，每条件每变体10次试验。

paper.title: VLAGuard: A Framework for Evaluating and Mitigating Physical Attention Hijacking in Vision-Language-Action Robots within Wireless Sensor Networks
paper.abstract: Abstract: Deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robots as mobile edge nodes within wireless sensor networks (WSNs) requires robust protection against physical adversarial threats. We present VLAGuard, a framework to assess and mitigate a critical vulnerability: policy-critical action-to-vision attention hijacking. We first introduce a stress-test module, Visuomotor Attention-guided Semantic Attack (VASA), using printable patches to severely distract the robot's action-conditioned cross-attention. To counter this, we propose Attention-Protective Fine-Tuning (APFT), a defense that stabilizes spatiotemporal attention and enforces geometric consistency with zero inference overhead. Evaluations across simulated and physical WSN-assisted smart environments demonstrate significant robustness gains. APFT reduces the OpenVLA failure rate from 100.0% to 25.9% in LIBERO simulations. Furthermore, across 2,000 real-world trials, APFT improves the average success rate from 23.0% to 67.4% under severe patch attacks. This highlights that protecting attention pathways is important for improving the robustness of VLA-driven edge nodes in sensor networks.

summary.oneLiner: VLAGuard提出针对VLA机器人“策略关键动作-视觉注意力劫持”的可打印补丁红队攻击VASA与零推理开销防御APFT，在LIBERO仿真与2000次真实试验中显著提升物理对抗鲁棒性。
summary.motivation: 将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人作为无线传感器网络（WSN）中的移动边缘节点部署时，需抵御物理世界中的局部可打印对抗补丁。现有攻击与防御多聚焦于动作偏移或全局表征破坏，但机器人操控依赖稀疏的任务关键视觉证据，且策略在动作生成时通过跨注意力从视觉token获取 grounding；该“策略关键动作到视觉的注意力劫持”通路在物理部署中尚未被充分诊断与防护。
summary.method: 提出VLAGuard双模块框架：（1）红队VASA（Visuomotor Attention-guided Semantic Attack），在EOT物理变换下优化可打印补丁，通过注意力引导、特征分散、图文错配与全变分正则联合目标，使补丁区域主导动作查询对视觉key的跨注意力，从而劫持策略关键注意力；（2）蓝队APFT（Attention-Protective Fine-Tuning），采用冻结Teacher处理干净轨迹、可训练Student处理VASA补丁轨迹的师生鲁棒微调，仅更新视觉编码器，联合特征锚定、策略关键注意力蒸馏（PCAD）、语言引导几何一致性与时序注意力一致性（TAC），在训练阶段恢复空间-时序 grounding，推理无额外开销。
summary.experimentSetup: 仿真：LIBERO四套件（Spatial/Object/Goal/Long），评测OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT与π₀；补丁尺寸含5×5、8×8、15×15、20×20 cm，EOT含±30°旋转、10%平移、0.85–1.15缩放等；白盒自适应攻击可梯度访问目标策略/防御。防御主分析集中于OpenVLA：APFT用AdamW（lr=2×10⁻⁵，wd=0.01），轨迹窗口K=4，λ_feat=0.5、λ_pcad=1.0、λ_geo=0.3、λ_tac=0.3；VASA权重λ_attn=0.8、λ_disp=0.2、λ_misalign=0.5。真实世界：WSN辅助智能环境2000次试验，severe patch攻击条件下对比原始策略与APFT。
results: VASA使OpenVLA在LIBERO四套件下平均失败率（FR）达100.0%；对OpenVLA-OFT由clean时2.4%–4.8%升至93.6%–100.0%；对π₀在Long套件达80.2% FR
VASA消融：仅优化L_attn（Attn only）的失败率显著高于Disp+Misalign，机制级注意力劫持是物理策略崩溃主因
APFT将OpenVLA在VASA攻击下平均FR从100.0%降至25.9%（降低74.1个百分点）；Spatial/Object/Goal/ Long分别为15.6%、12.8%、23.6%、51.4%
对比EDPA-AF：其在自适应VASA下平均FR为96.6%，APFT为25.9%
APFT在clean条件下平均FR约23.3%，与Original（23.2%）接近，clean性能基本保持
对Random Patch/UADA/UPA/EDPA等攻击，APFT平均FR约24.1%–25.7%
真实世界2000次试验：severe patch攻击下平均成功率由23.0%提升至67.4%

paper.title: Device-First Feedback: Toward Mobile-Native LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Search
paper.abstract: Abstract: Deploying convolutional neural networks generated by large language models (LLMs) on real mobile hardware requires more than GPU validation accuracy: INT8 TensorFlow Lite export, delegate selection, and on-device latency jointly determine whether a model is usable. We present an automated mobile deployment pipeline that closes the loop from QLoRA fine-tuning of an architecture-generating LLM through GPU evaluation, INT8 export, and physical-device benchmarking to gated augmentation of the training corpus. The pipeline is fully scripted and runs cycle-by-cycle without manual intervention, with resume support after interruptions. We evaluate the same frozen protocol on two benchmarks, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, on a Samsung SM-P613 tablet (seed 42, 20 models per cycle, cycles 0-6). On CIFAR-10, cycle 1 is gate-accepted and improves the mobile deployment score approximately 25.6x over the baseline with a mean quantized accuracy of 46.9%; later cycles raise GPU accuracy but fail the non-decreasing mobile gate. On CIFAR-100, the pre-QLoRA baseline retains the best mobile score; iterative rounds improve GPU accuracy (up to 26.2%) yet cannot surpass cycle 0 on-device, and the training pool stalls at 19 examples after the first accepted round. Together, the two studies show that closed-loop GPU fine-tuning does not guarantee monotonic mobile gains, especially on harder classification tasks, and that multi-dataset, on-device measurement is needed to stress-test deployment objectives. We release per-cycle metrics with 95% confidence intervals, all figures, and complete reproduction commands.

summary.oneLiner: 提出端到端自动化移动部署闭环：QLoRA微调架构生成LLM→GPU评估→INT8 TFLite导出→真机测速，并以移动部署得分门控训练语料增广。
summary.motivation: LLM生成的CNN能否在移动端可用，不能只看工作站GPU精度：INT8量化、TensorFlow Lite delegate选择与真机延迟共同决定部署质量；既有LLM架构生成工作多在PyTorch源域评估，缺少将物理设备INT8指标纳入迭代闭环的系统。
summary.method: 实现可脚本化、可断点续跑的MobileDeploymentFinetuner（TuneNNGen --mobile_deployment）。每轮：用上一轮训练池Dc-1对ABrain/NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag做QLoRA（3 epoch）→生成K=20个LEMUR兼容Net模块→各候选GPU训练1 epoch并按数据集阈值过滤→PTQ转INT8 TFLite→在Samsung SM-P613上对CPU/GPU/NNAPI各20次计时，取最小中位延迟t_best→在256张holdout上测INT8 top-1精度aint8→以部署得分score=aint8/t_best排序并做新颖性过滤；仅当s_max≥0.99·s_ref且至少2个有效模型时门控接受并增广chat训练池，否则池不变。
summary.experimentSetup: 冻结协议在CIFAR-10与CIFAR-100（32×32）上复用：seed 42，cycles 0–6（计划8轮），每轮20模型；GPU精度阈值CIFAR-10为0.40、CIFAR-100为0.20；基线cycle 0为未适配基模，后续轮次QLoRA+门控增广；移动评测为单台Samsung Galaxy Tab SM-P613（Android 14，USB真机非模拟器）；QLoRA与GPU训练在带NVIDIA GPU的Linux工作站上执行；报告每轮最佳/平均首epoch GPU精度、最佳移动得分、平均量化精度及有效移动模型数，95% CI为轮内Student’s t（n≈15–20）。

CIFAR-100：cycle 0（未QLoRA）保持全局最佳移动得分9.657×10⁻⁸，GPU最佳21.8%，平均量化精度1.2%±0.7%；cycle 1虽被接受（无先前门控参考）但移动得分5.115×10⁻⁸已低于基线，池仅增至19例；cycle 3最接近基线（8.613×10⁻⁸）仍被拒；cycle 6 GPU最佳26.2%为峰值，但移动得分2.183×10⁻⁸，平均量化精度约1.3%±0.3%

paper.title: Understanding Sparse Attention Selectivity in Long-Context Foundation Models via Counterfactual Evaluation
paper.abstract: Abstract: Sparse attention is widely deployed in long-context serving stacks, yet no framework audits how discarding blocks changes the influence of specific content on model output. We first establish that the phenomenon is real and causal: Block Sparse Flash Attention (BSFA) route replay across four architectures changes output decisions in 13 of 16 cells, with zero identity-replay label flips. We then introduce a dense-calibrated counterfactual audit using matched probe cards---Gold (carrying the correct answer label), Poison (carrying a target wrong label), and Benign (filler only)---under six-layout position symmetry, isolating the sparsification-specific effect. Two patterns compete. Signal concentration: the selector preserves Gold and Poison blocks far above filler-matched Benign blocks (G$\approx$P$\gg$B across all model--task pairs). Integration loss: discarding blocks severs cross-block attention---confirmed by an ablation where isolating the probe block collapses its influence from 4.48 logits to zero. Compression ratio governs the balance: a full sweep from mild ($c=0.25$) to aggressive ($c=0.75$) compression across four model--task pairs reveals that three of four cells move toward stronger sparse amplification at higher compression, with two exhibiting sign reversals. Three independent arms---BSFA route replay, controlled block-top-$k$, and KV-cache eviction---converge: sparsification changes content influence in ways aggregate accuracy cannot detect. We provide an open measurement framework deployable on any model exposing block identities.

summary.oneLiner: 提出密集校准反事实审计框架，证明长上下文稀疏注意力会因果性地、按内容类型改变证据块对模型输出的影响，且聚合准确率无法捕捉此类偏移。
summary.motivation: 稀疏注意力已成为长上下文服务栈的标准基础设施，但现有评估仅关注吞吐、显存与聚合基准准确率，无法审计“丢弃哪些块”如何改变特定内容对输出的行为性影响；聚合指标在正负方向效应相互抵消时会给出空结果（三项预指定 pooled 检验经 Holm 校正后 p=0.995、0.771、0.541），部署模型可能在平均准确率不变的同时放大误导内容、压制正确证据。
summary.method: 首先用 Block Sparse Flash Attention（BSFA）强制路由重放建立因果性：同一内核路径下仅操纵可见块，度量 wrong-route 减 force-gold 的答案 margin gap。继而提出密集校准反事实审计：在 128-token 块、最终 query 行 exact-score top-k 稀疏算子下，构造匹配的 Gold（正确标签）、Poison（错误目标标签）、Benign（纯填充）探针卡，经六布局位置对称与 forced routing 隔离稀疏化特异效应，以 Δ=sparse−dense 校准对比。辅以跨块通道消融验证 integration loss，并以 KVPress（Expected Attention、SnapKV）KV-cache 驱逐作为第三独立臂三角验证。
summary.experimentSetup: 覆盖 Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-8B 四类 7B–8B 开源架构；任务为 SCBench-KV（SCB）与 SciFact（SF）科学声明验证。BSFA 与受控协议在 c∈{0.25,0.50,0.75} 下评估，clean-correct 队列每 model–task cell n=58–100；受控 thin-probe 每 cell n=16；KVPress 在 Qwen2.5-7B/Qwen3-8B、n=100 SciFact 上于 c∈{0.25,0.50} 运行。推理统一 float16（BSFA/受控用 eager attention，dense 校准臂用 native sdpa）；每条反事实路由独立完整前向；置信区间基于 10,000 次 item-clustered bootstrap，随机化检验 100,000 次 blocked sign flip 并经 Holm 族校正。共 52 个评估 cell（16 BSFA、24 受控、8 KVPress、4 个 c=0.75 thin-probe）。
results: BSFA 路由重放：16 个 model–task–ratio cell 中 13 个显著为正、0 个显著为负、3 个 null；identity replay 全程 0 次标签翻转；显著正 gap 范围 0.022–2.078 logits，最大为 Qwen3-8B@SciFact、c=0.25 的 +2.078 [+1.705,+2.474]
信号集中（signal concentration）：所有 model–task 对上 Gold 与 Poison 块保留率均远高于匹配的 Benign（G≈P≫B）
整合损失（integration loss）：跨块注意力消融显示，隔离探针块可将其影响从 4.48 logits 坍缩至 0
压缩比扫描：四组 model–task 中三组随 c 从 0.25 升至 0.75 稀疏放大增强，两组出现符号反转；c=0 内核路径基线相对主效应可忽略（100% 标签一致，mean |H3| path diff=0.044，相对 0.47–2.15 logits 主效应）
KVPress：Qwen2.5-7B 上 Expected Attention/SnapKV 的 paired compression-minus-dense 中毒率变化约 −0.0115 至 −0.0144；Qwen3-8B 上约 −0.1000 至 −0.1644（均为负，95% CI 不含 0）
三独立方法（BSFA 重放、受控 block-top-k、KV-cache 驱逐）方向收敛：稀疏执行改变内容影响的方式是聚合准确率无法检测的
summary.trainingResources: 论文未披露训练算力或 GPU 规模；工作仅表征推理时稀疏化，未研究训练阶段动态。推理侧披露：模型以 float16 加载，每条反事实路由触发独立完整前向，bootstrap 使用 10,000 次重采样。
limitations: 受控协议固定 128-token 块大小且仅在最终 query 行选择，更大/可变块或在其他层选择可能产生不同路由
thin label-token 探针刻意极简，无法捕获复合语义信号（以 n=16/cell 的 real-evidence 探针部分弥补）
KVPress 使用 poisoning rate change，与受控协议 Δ 数值不可直接横比，收敛为方向性而非定量对齐
仅覆盖 7B–8B 参数级四类架构，更大模型缩放行为未验证
填充内容会非中性地影响选择器，审计需将格式/填充惯例纳入而非默认中性
仅测量推理时稀疏化，不涉及训练时动态
summary.significance: 首次提供可部署于任意暴露块身份模型的开放测量框架，用密集校准、反事实路由重放与对称控制使稀疏化对内容影响的改变可观测、可归因、可跨 BSFA/受控 top-k/KV 驱逐路径比较；揭示 practitioners 在部署稀疏注意力时必须追问、而聚合 benchmark 无法回答的核心问题：块选择如何重塑特定证据的行为影响力。

paper.title: SeDeM: Selective Decompression of Hidden-State Memories for Long-Context Question Answering
paper.abstract: Abstract: Long-context inference with large language models (LLMs) is costly: self-attention during prefill scales quadratically with sequence length, and the key-value (KV) cache grows with the number of processed tokens. Larger context windows also do not ensure reliable evidence use. Context compression reduces this cost, but many soft-compression methods use LLMs as compressors and rely on compact memory tokens both to preserve information and to condition the decoder. We propose SeDeM, a selective decompression framework that decouples compact memory storage from decoder conditioning. An LLM extracts hidden states from a chosen intermediate Transformer layer, a lightweight compressor stores them as memory blocks, a query-conditioned selector selects relevant blocks, and a decompressor expands only the selected blocks into hidden states compatible with an intermediate decoder layer. Thus, the decoder avoids both full-context processing and direct generation from highly compressed memory slots. On four long-context QA benchmarks, SeDeM achieves higher QA scores than the evaluated compression baselines in both 1B and 3B same-backbone settings, and with the 3B backbone exceeds full-context fine-tuning on three datasets. The learned selector uses block-level evidence supervision during training. SeDeM also reduces online time-to-first-token and improves autoregressive decoding throughput relative to ICAE.

summary.oneLiner: SeDeM将长上下文分段压缩为紧凑隐状态记忆块，按查询Top-K选取相关块并解压注入解码器中间层，在四项长上下文QA上优于多种压缩基线，并在3B骨干上于三个数据集超过全上下文微调。
summary.motivation: 长上下文推理中prefill自注意力随序列长度二次增长、KV cache随token数膨胀，成本高昂；更大上下文窗口也不能保证可靠利用证据，尤其当证据不在首尾时。现有软压缩方法常让LLM同时承担压缩与解码条件化，紧凑记忆槽既要存信息又要作为解码前缀，高压缩比下直接条件化路径受限，且可能覆盖早期层聚合的局部信息。
summary.method: SeDeM将“紧凑存储”与“解码条件化”解耦：冻结LLM在选定中间层ℓ_extract对上下文分段做提取pass得到隐状态；轻量非注意力压缩器将每段池化为紧凑记忆块；查询条件选择器在训练时用块级证据监督学习Top-K选取；解压器仅将选中块扩展为与解码器中间层ℓ_inject兼容的隐状态并注入，再由（可LoRA适配的）解码pass生成答案。记忆构建与查询无关，可复用；解码计算规模由选择预算K而非全长决定；亦支持1B编码器+3B解码器的跨模型设置。
summary.experimentSetup: 在2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue、QASPER、HotpotQA-Distractor四项长上下文QA上评估；骨干为Llama-3.2-1B-Base与3B-Base，对比冻结/全上下文微调参考、LongLLMLingua、HMT、ICAE、500xCompressor、Activation Beacon；报告token级F1与ROUGE-L；效率在与ICAE对比中测量含在线压缩/选择/解码prefill的TTFT（ms）与解码吞吐（tok/s）；理论FLOPs在N_ctx=2048、N_q=30、N_ans=16下报告；另做解压必要性、选择预算K、解码器LoRA、块结构压缩、粒度、零样本QASPER与RULER qa_2（4K、500例）等消融/诊断。
results: Llama-3.2-1B：SeDeM F1/ROUGE-L为2Wiki 55.69/55.66、MuSiQue 18.63/18.55、QASPER 23.82/22.88、HotpotQA-Distractor 50.93/50.82，均高于表中全部压缩基线，并高于同骨干全上下文微调参考（49.36/49.28、16.96/16.67、21.42/19.58、29.16/22.92）。
Llama-3.2-3B：SeDeM为67.25/67.14、21.85/21.68、26.74/25.74、58.30（Hotpot ROUGE-L未给出配对修正值）；在2Wiki、QASPER、Hotpot上超过全上下文微调（62.50/62.49、23.44/21.50、36.73/36.56），MuSiQue低于全上下文微调（21.85 vs 32.54 F1）。
相对ICAE效率：1B平均TTFT 46.56 vs 81.07 ms（1.74×更快），吞吐77.78 vs 71.82 tok/s（1.08×）；3B平均TTFT 79.60 vs 195.76 ms（2.46×），吞吐45.16 vs 41.17 tok/s（1.10×）；QASPER上3B TTFT优势最大（96.50 vs 364.10 ms，3.77×）。
理论推理FLOPs/查询：1B SeDeM 3243.6 GFLOPs vs ICAE 5088.4；3B 5753.3 vs 14589.6。
归一化有效秩：SeDeM平均78.7% vs ICAE 52.3%（分数据集67.4–92.3 vs 40.6–60.6）。
解压消融（3B）：无解压线性/MLP在QASPER为18.06/18.30 F1、Hotpot为29.69/30.13，SeDeM为26.74/49.39。
选择预算K（1B）：Hotpot在K=2时F1 50.93（EM 38.42）最佳，K增至10降至45.65；2Wiki在K=8时F1 57.42（EM 51.10）峰值后饱和。
零样本QASPER（匹配两阶段训练、训练集无QASPER）：SeDeM 20.02 F1 vs ICAE 11.30。
RULER qa_2@4K（3B，500例）：SeDeM 31.6（相对全上下文保留64.0%）vs ICAE 11.2（22.7%）。
summary.trainingResources: 论文未披露SeDeM训练所用GPU型号、数量或总训练时长/算力小时。已披露内容：骨干为冻结Llama-3.2-1B/3B，可训练模块含压缩器（1B 4.21M/3B 9.46M）、解压器（20.99M/47.21M）、选择器（8.40M/18.89M）与解码器LoRA（13.63M/36.70M）；选择器用块级证据标签监督（推理时不使用）；零样本迁移实验采用与ICAE匹配的两阶段流程（SlimPajama压缩预训练+多任务QA适配）。基线复现细节（如Activation Beacon在200M token SlimPajama上1 epoch、DeepSpeed ZeRO-2/3、有效batch 8等）主要针对对比方法，不能直接等同于SeDeM本体训练开销。
limitations: 选择器依赖四项基准提供的块级证据标签；无标签时可用关闭选择器的模式，但失去Top-K带来的效率收益，从弱监督学习选择仍待研究。
仅在Llama-3.2-1B/3B上验证，更大骨干上质量与效率优势是否保持未知。
提取层与注入层为经验选取，缺乏在新骨干族上可泛化的系统化选取流程；未在更广长上下文套件或显著更长上下文上评估。
3B SeDeM在MuSiQue上仍低于全上下文微调（21.85 vs 32.54 F1）；更大K可部分回收证据但会增加注入层以上计算、削弱效率。
延迟在完全在线协议下测量（含分段、编码、压缩、选择、解压）；未评估预计算查询无关文档记忆等系统级优化。
summary.significance: SeDeM表明将“查询无关的紧凑隐状态存储”与“查询相关的选择性解压+中间层注入”分离，可兼顾长上下文QA质量与推理效率：在多项基准上超越主流硬/软压缩与KV/激活压缩基线，并在3B设置下于三个数据集超过全上下文微调，同时相对ICAE显著降低TTFT并略提吞吐；消融支持增益主要来自选择性解压而非单纯更强压缩器，且设计支持记忆复用与跨规模编解码分离。

idea.title: Conflict-Attributed Memory Quarantine (CAMQ): A Factorial Test of Earliest-Reasoning-Conflict Localization for Retrieve-Time Memory Poisoning Defense
idea.hypothesis: On a held-out 350-session (target 500 if budget permits) stratified confirmation split of LongMemEval-MemoryGraft, disjoint from the pilot split, with quarantine triggered only by the fully automatic adjudicator A_auto: (i) staged attribution funnel yields global recall R_glob >= 0.30 of all injected poison chunks and precision >= 0.60 among adjudicated attributions, with session-clustered bootstrap 95% CI lower bounds >= 0.22 recall and >= 0.50 precision; (ii) in a 2x2 factorial over delta-ranking (on/off) and one localized debate round (on/off), evaluated on a locked shared pool of disagreement events with matched candidate sets and matched quarantine budget, the delta-ranking main effect on ASR@3 has a session-clustered 95% CI lower bound > 0; (iii) CAMQ-full reduces ASR@3 versus MAPLE-Guard-only with clustered CI lower bound > 0 while MDSR@3 drops by no more than 5 absolute points and quarantine rate and end-to-end latency do not exceed the rate-matched random-quarantine control; (iv) CAMQ-full also exceeds MAPLE-plus-disagreement-flag and CiteTrust-only. If the delta-ranking main-effect CI lower bound is <= 0, the pre-registered written conclusion is that earliest-reasoning-conflict localization provides no incremental value over verbatim-citation-plus-provenance gating, with no substitution of alternative metrics.
idea.motivation: MAPLE-Guard reduces ASR on memory-graft and app-poisoning attacks but leaves retrieve-time latent harm, trades against MDSR, and offers no reasoning-time signal identifying which retrieved item to isolate. LMAD shows multi-agent failures originate at the earliest divergent intermediate claim and propagate downstream, so answer-level or write-time guards cannot pinpoint that locus. Three rounds of adversarial review reshaped the design: human adjudication inside the defense loop made the mechanism undeployable and leaked labels, so adjudication is now fully automatic; disagreement-conditioned recall flattered the method, so attribution is now measured as a staged funnel over all injected chunks with silent-consensus failures counted against the method; deletion-based masking confounded chunk causality with context perturbation, so counterfactuals now use same-rank same-length benign substitution with full-trajectory multi-seed replay; and, decisively, a CiteTrust-only baseline differing from CAMQ by two factors could not attribute gains to conflict localization, so the core claim is now tested by a 2x2 factorial isolating the delta-ranking main effect. Cost is no longer asserted but derived from a pilot-measured formula behind a hard gate.
method: Run a mandatory 50-session stratified pilot on LongMemEval-MemoryGraft with Qwen2.5-14B that is permanently disjoint from the confirmation split; the pilot measures disagreement rate d, candidates per session n_cand, mean session token length, A_auto trigger rate, and the intra-cluster correlation of attack outcomes within session x injected-chunk, and its sessions are never reused in any confirmation analysis.

Gate the confirmation run on the pilot: unlock only if pilot A_auto precision >= 0.55, pilot stage-conditional recall (attributed given retrieved and cited) >= 0.40, and the instantiated cost formula C_total = C_arms + C_replay, with C_replay = n_cand x 3 seeds x mean session tokens x c_token, projects <= 750 GPU-hours including audit and replay reruns; otherwise the confirmation run is not started and the pilot is reported as a negative feasibility result.

Deploy the 3-agent persistent-memory stack on LongMemEval-MemoryGraft with Qwen2.5-14B served by vLLM on <= 8 H100 GPUs, temperature schedule 0.1/0.5/0.9 for debating agents and temperature 0 for all auxiliary extractors, locators, and parsers, all with fixed seeds and immutable logs.

At retrieve time log immutable (query, chunk_id, rank, session, turn) tuples; bind reasoning atoms to memory exclusively through verbatim citation spans. Cosine >= 0.85 matches against the last k=5 retrieved chunks generate candidates only and never constitute attribution evidence.

Trigger the online adjudicator A_auto only on answer or proposed-tool-action disagreement, and quarantine a chunk_id only when all three conditions hold: a verbatim citation span binds a reasoning atom to that chunk_id, a second agent's witness prefix S_j independently cites the same chunk_id, and that chunk's MAPLE provenance-trust falls below the paper-fixed threshold. Human adjudication is excluded from the defense loop entirely and used only for offline label quality, reported as A_auto-versus-human agreement with kappa >= 0.7 as the label-quality target; every defense number cites A_auto alone.

Quarantine action is fixed and identical across all arms that quarantine: block shared promotion, set the taint flag, and exclude the chunk from top-m retrieval for a fixed number of subsequent rounds, leaving MAPLE write/retrieve/promotion/reuse gates unchanged.

Run the primary comparison as a locked five-condition set plus a 2x2 factorial: no defense; MAPLE-Guard-only with paper-fixed thresholds; MAPLE-plus-disagreement-flag (logs disagreements, never quarantines); rate-matched random quarantine with matched rank distribution and matched taint duration; and the 2x2 cells CiteTrust-only (no delta-ranking, no debate), CiteTrust+delta-ranking, CiteTrust+localized debate, and CAMQ-full (delta-ranking plus one localized debate round on S_i). The four factorial cells operate on the same locked pool of logged disagreement events, the same generated candidate sets, and the same per-session quarantine budget, so that neither trigger coverage nor retrieval-exposure reduction can differ between cells; shared trace prefixes are reused across cells to keep the factorial affordable.

Validate causality with counterfactual replay for each attributed candidate: replace the chunk with a same-rank, same-length benign chunk (a benign chunk retrieved in the same session, or a topic- and length-preserving neutral rewrite), replay the full session trajectory from the first turn without reusing post-delta cache, across 3 seeds. Count a true positive only when delta disappears or moves later and the attack outcome flips in at least 2 of 3 seeds, and when the paired flip-rate difference versus random same-rank benign substitution has a clustered CI lower bound > 0. Include a high-utility benign control whose flip rate must not exceed the random-substitution flip rate, giving an explicit false-positive upper bound.

Report attribution as a staged funnel rather than a single number: injected -> retrieved -> cited -> conflict-triggering -> A_auto-attributed -> causally confirmed, with the silent-consensus rate (attack succeeds and all agents agree) reported separately and counted as attribution failure in the R_glob denominator, never excluded.

Perform all hypothesis tests and intervals with hierarchical cluster bootstrap resampling whole sessions and then injected chunks within session (1000 resamples), publishing ICC, design effect, and effective sample size; pre-register the three-way conclusion (superior when the paired-difference CI lower bound > 0, indeterminate, degraded) and forbid reading a non-significant interval as evidence of no incremental value or as evidence of parity.

Cap cost with disagreement-triggered LMAD rather than per-step invocation, a 10-iteration LMAD maximum, exactly one localized debate round, and a hard stop at 750 GPU-hours; execute the pre-registered concession ladder in fixed order when projections exceed budget: drop AppWorld-AgentPoison, then drop the 100-session ablation slice, then reduce the confirmation split from 500 to 350 sessions, then reduce replay seeds from 3 to 2. The five primary conditions, the 2x2 factorial, clustered inference, and the pilot/confirmation split separation are never cut.
evaluation: Primary defense metrics: ASR@1/2/3 and MDSR@1/2/3 on the held-out LongMemEval-MemoryGraft confirmation split, mirroring MAPLE-Guard reporting and stratified by attack channel, with paired differences computed per attack event and inference by hierarchical session-level cluster bootstrap.

Primary novelty test: the delta-ranking main effect and the delta x debate interaction estimated from the 2x2 factorial on the locked shared conflict-event pool with matched candidate sets and matched quarantine budget; the delta main-effect clustered CI lower bound > 0 is the sole decisive criterion for claiming that earliest-conflict localization adds value.

Attribution validity: staged funnel rates (injected -> retrieved -> cited -> conflict -> attributed -> causally confirmed) with R_glob >= 0.30 and adjudicated precision >= 0.60, clustered CI lower bounds >= 0.22 and >= 0.50 respectively, plus the separately reported silent-consensus rate; conditional recall given disagreement is reported as a diagnostic only and never as a headline result.

Label-quality reporting: A_auto versus offline human labels on 200 stratified conflict events, reported as agreement and kappa; these human labels never enter any defense metric or any quarantine decision.

Causal controls: flip rates under attributed-chunk benign substitution, random same-rank benign substitution, and high-utility benign substitution, all with full-trajectory multi-seed replay, reported as paired differences with clustered intervals.

Non-inferiority guardrails reported alongside every ASR claim: MDSR@3 drop <= 5 points, quarantine rate no higher than the rate-matched random control, and end-to-end latency plus retrieval-call count versus MAPLE-Guard-only; an ASR gain purchased by higher quarantine rate, MDSR loss, or latency blowup is reported as a failed claim.
Pilot report published regardless of outcome: disagreement rate, candidates per session, ICC and effective sample size, instantiated cost formula, and the resulting unlock or no-unlock decision.

External validity, explicitly optional and first on the concession ladder: AppWorld-AgentPoison on MAPLE-Guard-only and CAMQ-full only, reported separately and never pooled with LongMemEval; a 50-session Gemma3-12B cross-backbone attribution-stability slice only if the primary run finishes under budget.
idea.expectedContribution: The first falsifiable, factorially identified test of whether earliest-reasoning-conflict localization carries incremental retrieve-time signal for memory-chain poisoning beyond verbatim-citation-plus-provenance gating, delivered with a fully automatic adjudicator that keeps human labels out of the defense loop, a staged attribution funnel that counts silent-consensus failures against the method, same-rank benign-substitution counterfactuals with random and high-utility controls that separate causal effect from context perturbation, session-clustered inference with published ICC and effective sample size, and a pilot-derived cost model with a pre-registered concession ladder that protects internal validity under a 750 GPU-hour hard cap.
idea.impactAssessment: A confirmed delta-ranking main effect would establish reasoning-conflict localization as a deployable retrieve-time isolation signal, lowering latent memory-graft ASR where rule-only lifecycle guards underperform, at inference-time engineering cost with no training. A null or indeterminate delta effect with a strong CiteTrust-only baseline would be equally valuable: it would redirect memory-defense research away from reasoning-conflict heuristics toward citation-provenance integrity, content models, and metadata authentication, and would document quantitatively how much of the apparent benefit of conflict-based defenses is really citation-and-trust filtering.
idea.noveltyAssessment: Moderate to low and openly incremental: witness-to-memory attribution is a heuristic fusion of LMAD localized debate with MAPLE-Guard lifecycle enforcement rather than a new security primitive. The genuinely new elements are the factorial identification of the delta-localization component against a same-rule CiteTrust-only baseline, the automatic three-condition binding protocol, the staged funnel attribution metric, and the counterfactual substitution criterion. If CiteTrust-only captures most of the ASR reduction, the novelty of this work reduces to the negative result and the measurement protocol, an outcome the proposal accepts in advance.
idea.resourceAssessment: Inference-only with no fine-tuning: vLLM-served Qwen2.5-14B on <= 8 H100 GPUs, well under the 8 x 7 x 24 = 1344 GPU-hour envelope, with a self-imposed 750 GPU-hour hard stop. Multi-seed full-trajectory counterfactual replay is the cost-dominant term and is the reason the confirmation split may land at 350 rather than 500 sessions; the 2x2 factorial is made affordable by sharing logged trace prefixes and a single locked conflict-event pool across cells rather than running independent full sweeps. All cost estimates are pilot-instantiated through C_replay = n_cand x 3 seeds x mean session tokens x c_token, and the run does not start if projections exceed the cap.
idea.trainingResources: None. CAMQ is an inference-time protocol over frozen LLM backbones plus deterministic extractors, locators, parsers, and fixed-threshold MAPLE-Guard provenance scoring.
risks: CiteTrust-only may capture most of the ASR reduction, giving a delta-ranking main effect whose clustered CI lower bound is <= 0 and reducing the contribution to a negative result plus measurement protocol.
Even at 350-500 sessions with session-level clustering, effective sample size may be too small to resolve a 2-3pp effect, leaving the primary comparisons in the pre-registered indeterminate band.

Same-rank benign substitution still perturbs downstream generation, so outcome flips may partly reflect distributional disturbance rather than the poison chunk's causal role; the random and high-utility controls bound but do not eliminate this.
Atomic-chain extraction on a 14B backbone may be too noisy for reliable delta localization, collapsing funnel recall below R_glob 0.30 even after the pilot gate.
A_auto's three-condition conjunction structurally covers only explicit-restatement attacks; silent-consensus poisoning is counted as failure by design and remains uncovered.
Provenance metadata is assumed honest; forged chunk lineage bypasses the trust condition and therefore the entire quarantine trigger.
Tool-centric InjectAgent-style attacks that bypass retrieved textual memory are out of scope, and the AppWorld slice is exploratory, two-arm, and first to be cut under budget pressure.
Multi-seed full-trajectory replay may dominate cost enough to force the concession ladder down to 350 sessions and 2 seeds, weakening both power and causal confirmation strength.
Disagreement-triggered LMAD plus a localized debate round may push end-to-end latency past practical deployment limits on long-horizon sessions even while staying inside the GPU-hour cap.

Instituted mandatory 50-session pilot gate requiring attribution precision≥0.55, recall≥0.40, and projected end-to-end compute≤750 GPU-hours before unlocking 500-session primary run
Scoped AppWorld-AgentPoison to two-arm exploratory reporting decoupled from core LongMemEval acceptance criteria
refinements.revisedHypothesis: On LongMemEval-MemoryGraft (500-session stratified subset, unlocked only after a 50-session pilot passes attribution and compute gates), CAMQ will achieve δ-to-poison chunk_id recall≥0.50 with precision≥0.60 on 200 stratified conflict audits (95% CI lower bounds ≥0.40 recall and ≥0.50 precision), and quarantining only adjudicated-attributed chunk_ids with MAPLE-Guard active will reduce ASR@3 by≥5 absolute percentage points versus MAPLE-Guard-only without reducing MDSR@3 by more than 5 points; CAMQ must beat MAPLE-plus-disagreement-flag by≥2pp ASR@3 to claim incremental witness-attribution value.

Four-arm primary LongMemEval protocol: no defense, MAPLE-Guard-only (paper-fixed thresholds), MAPLE-plus-disagreement-flag (logs disagreements; no quarantine), and CAMQ-full; rate-matched random demotion and CAMQ-without-quarantine relegated to a 100-session ablation slice executed only if the pilot passes.

3-agent persistent-memory stack on LongMemEval-MemoryGraft (500-session stratified subset) using Qwen2.5-14B via vLLM on≤8 H100 GPUs; AppWorld-AgentPoison limited to MAPLE-Guard-only and CAMQ-full two-arm reporting, not pooled with LongMemEval acceptance.

Retrieve-time immutable (query, chunk_id, rank) logging; automatic quarantine bound exclusively to verbatim citation spans; cosine≥0.85 matches against last-k=5 retrieved chunks are candidate-only and excluded from quarantine unless confirmed by second-agent witness or human adjudication on the 200-audit sample.

On answer or proposed-tool-action disagreement only, run LMAD extractor E and locator L for earliest conflict node δ and per-agent witness prefixes S_i; rank poison candidates by cross-agent witness frequency intersecting MAPLE provenance-trust scores below paper-fixed threshold.

Quarantine solely adjudicated-attributed chunk_ids: block shared promotion, set taint flag, exclude from top-m retrieval; exactly one localized debate round on S_i while leaving MAPLE write/retrieve/promotion/reuse gates unchanged.
