Cost cap: disagreement-triggered LMAD only, 10-iteration LMAD max, one localized debate round, temperature schedule 0.1/0.5/0.9, auxiliary modules at temperature 0, hard stop at 750 GPU-hours for primary four-arm LongMemEval protocol including audit reruns.
refinements.rationale: Round-3 revisions credibly address feasibility (four-arm primary, pilot gate, 750 GPU-hour cap fits within 8×H100×7-day=1344 GPU-hour envelope) and strengthen evaluation rigor (asymmetric attribution floors, MAPLE-plus-disagreement control, adjudicated verbatim binding). Impact is meaningful but incremental over MAPLE-Guard. Novelty remains the blocking deficit: CAMQ is a heuristic orchestration of existing LMAD conflict localization and MAPLE-Guard lifecycle enforcement without a new security primitive, learned attribution model, or mechanistic insight into memory poisoning; the adjudicated binding protocol is methodological hygiene rather than a distinct scientific contribution. Under the acceptance rule requiring all three scores≥4, novelty at 3 mandates rejection despite acceptable impact and feasibility.

debate.topic: Whether Conflict-Attributed Memory Quarantine (CAMQ) — using earliest-reasoning-conflict localization as a retrieve-time signal to quarantine poisoned memory chunks — is a defensible, falsifiable research program executable on 8 H100s for 7 days.

turns.claim:
CAMQ 值得执行，核心价值不在新颖度而在可证伪性：它把一个两篇源论文都未直接检验的经验问题——「最早推理冲突 δ 能否定位被投毒 chunk」——转成预注册硬阈值，证实与证伪同样有信息量。针对二轮批评我做四处可操作加固：(1) 统计效力：三臂共享同一注入种子与会话集，采用配对设计；「≥2pp 优于 MAPLE+disagreement-flag」须同时满足点估计≥2pp 与 McNemar 精确检验单侧 p<0.05，任一不满足即判为无增量价值，禁止事后调阈值或调门控。(2) 审计有效性：200 次冲突审计改为序贯抽样至「抽满 150 个被归因 chunk_id」为止，避免归因集过小导致 CI 过宽；两名评审对臂与条件盲评，Cohen's κ≥0.7 方可计入，不达标则重训评审并重抽。(3) MDSR 保护：隔离改为可逆——taint 仅在后续 k=3 轮生效，被人工裁决推翻即解除；新增次级安全指标「良性 chunk 误隔离率 FQR≤2%」，任一臂越限即早停并如实报告。(4) 预算闭环：pilot 的唯一职责是测出真实分歧触发率 d 与单次 LMAD 的 token 成本 c，将总量外推为 base+d·c·N；若>750 GPU-hour 就不解锁 500 会话主实验，且不允许靠砍臂数硬凑。

我承认的弱点：novelty 确为增量式，CAMQ 是 LMAD 定位与 MAPLE 生命周期门控的启发式融合，不是新安全原语；2pp 相对 500 会话的抽样噪声偏小，所以必须用配对检验而非独立比例判定；14B 原子链抽取噪声可能使 recall 在 pilot 阶段就低于 0.40，此时应直接终止并报告负结果，而非换更大骨干救场；伪造 provenance 与 InjectAgent 式绕过文本记忆的工具攻击不在射程内，AppWorld 两臂结果仅作探索性报告，不参与核心接受判据。
evidence: 缺口：MAPLE-Guard 在 write/retrieve/promotion/reuse 处做规则门控，报告 ASR 下降但伴随 MDSR 回退，且不产生任何推理期信号指示「该隔离哪一条检索项」，retrieve-time 潜伏危害仍未覆盖。
机制：LMAD 显示多智能体错误可回溯到最早分歧的中间断言并向下游传播，答案层判别无法定位该 locus；δ 因此是唯一能直接映射回不可变 (query, chunk_id, rank) 日志的推理期锚点。
预算算术：推理-only、无微调；四臂×500 会话 + 100 会话消融 + 50 会话 pilot，LMAD 由分歧触发而非逐步触发、上限 10 轮、局部辩论仅 1 轮，主实验硬停 750 GPU-hour，低于 8×7×24=1344 上限，AppWorld 限两臂。
判据可算性：序贯抽满 150 个归因项时，观测 precision 约 0.57–0.60 即可让二项 95% CI 下界≥0.50；非对称阈值 (recall≥0.50 / precision≥0.60) 正是对「噪声抽取下 recall 更易受损」的显式让步，而非放宽标准。

turns.claim: CAMQ 的关键问题不是阈值，而是干预定义尚不闭合。方案称“仅隔离经裁决归因的 chunk_id”，但人工裁决只覆盖 200 个审计事件：若主实验在线使用人工裁决，就是不可部署的人工 oracle；若仅用第二代理见证自动裁决，则与审计标签并非同一机制，必须分别报告性能。其次，归因评估只抽取已触发分歧的冲突事件，会条件化掉“各代理一致接受毒记忆”的隐蔽失败；因此 conflict-conditional recall≥0.50 不能证明对全部 poison chunk 的召回。δ 也未必具有因果性：最早可观测分歧可能只是代理随机性、知识差异或上游良性记忆造成，毒块可能仅在更晚节点发挥作用。500 会话上的≥2pp仅约10个结局差异，即便配对检验也很可能功效不足，不能把“不显著”解释为无增量价值。决定性测试应是：锁定纯自动在线裁决器；以所有注入毒块为召回分母并单列无分歧攻击；对候选块做遮蔽/替换反事实重放验证δ及结局是否消失；预先按配对不一致率做功效分析，若500样本无法对2pp达到80%功效，就扩大样本或把判据改为区间估计。还应加入同率、同rank、同taint时长的随机隔离，排除收益仅来自降低检索暴露。
evidence: “人工裁决仅用于200审计”与“仅隔离经裁决chunk”存在机制歧义；离线标签参与防御会造成标签泄漏和不可部署性。
分歧触发采样估计的是P(定位成功｜发生分歧)，不是对全部投毒插入的召回；一致受骗案例被结构性排除。
500个配对样本中2pp约等于10例净改善；McNemar功效取决于不一致对数量，增加显著性门槛不能补足低功效。
反事实移除候选毒块后δ与攻击结局是否共同消失，比共现、余弦匹配或见证频率更能检验因果归因。

turns.claim:
我接受三项核心批评并据此改判据：干预必须完全自动、召回分母必须是全部注入毒块、2pp 不能当阈值判定。

(1) 裁决器闭合。锁定纯在线自动裁决器 A_auto：仅当同时满足 (i) 存在逐字引用跨度绑定到某 chunk_id、(ii) 第二代理见证前缀 S_j 独立引用同一 chunk、(iii) 该 chunk 的 MAPLE provenance-trust 低于论文固定阈值，才触发隔离。人工裁决彻底退出防御回路，只用于离线标签；分别报告 A_auto 与人工标签的一致性（κ≥0.7）以及 A_auto 独立的 precision/recall，防御结论只引用 A_auto 数字，消除标签泄漏与不可部署性。

(2) 召回分母。主报告改为全局召回 R_glob = 被归因毒块 / 全部注入毒块，预注册 R_glob≥0.30；原条件召回 R_cond≥0.50 降级为诊断量。另单列「静默共识率」= 攻击成功且各代理一致接受的比例，这类事件在 R_glob 分母内一律记为归因失败，不得排除。这等于公开承认 CAMQ 对无分歧隐蔽失败结构性无覆盖。

(3) 因果性检验。对每个候选 chunk 做遮蔽/良性改写反事实重放（固定种子与温度调度）：判为真正例须 δ 消失或后移且攻击结局翻转，命中率≥0.60；并设良性对照，遮蔽高效用良性 chunk 不应翻转结局。共现与余弦≥0.85 从此完全不作为归因证据，仅作候选生成。

(4) 统计判据。放弃「点估计≥2pp 即通过」。配对单位由会话改为攻击事件（会话×注入通道），pilot 先测不一致对率并做功效分析；若 500 会话对 2pp 达不到 80% 功效，改为区间判定，预注册三分结论：优越（配对差 95% CI 下界>0）、不确定、劣化，禁止把不显著读作无增量价值。

(5) 控制臂。同率、同 rank、同 taint 时长的随机隔离由消融升为主实验必需臂，在 250 会话共享种子配对子集上执行，排除收益仅来自降低检索暴露。

承认的弱点：novelty 仍是 LMAD 定位与 MAPLE 门控的增量融合；R_glob≥0.30 意味着多数毒块可能无法定位；反事实重放增加约 40–60 GPU-hour，为守住 750 小时硬顶取消 Gemma3 跨骨干切片；伪造 provenance 与工具侧绕过文本记忆的攻击不在射程。
evidence: A_auto 的三重合取（逐字引用 + 第二代理独立见证 + provenance-trust 低于固定阈值）使在线隔离完全不依赖离线标签；人工裁决只用于验证标签质量，两套数字分开报告，机制歧义消除。
分歧触发采样确实只估 P(定位成功|发生分歧)，故主指标改用全部注入毒块作分母（R_glob≥0.30）并单列静默共识率，一致受骗样本计入失败而非被排除。
反事实重放（遮蔽/良性改写后 δ 与攻击结局是否共同消失，含良性对照）是区分共现与因果的可执行判据；重放可复用缓存前缀、只重跑 δ 之后的链，成本约 40–60 GPU-hour。
配对单位由会话改为攻击事件可将 N 提升数倍；若功效仍不足 80%，预注册区间三分结论（优越/不确定/劣化），避免以低功效的不显著充当阴性证据。

turns.claim: 修订消除了人工 oracle，却引入了新的识别问题。A_auto 的三重合取几乎预设“毒块必须被两代理逐字引用且低信任”，因此只能处理显式复述型攻击；R_glob≥0.30虽诚实，却不能证明δ定位有增量价值。应增加不使用δ的“引用一致+低信任”基线，否则收益可能完全来自引用/provenance过滤。把配对单位改成“攻击事件”也不会自动增加有效样本量：同一会话、毒块和代理轨迹内事件高度相关，按独立事件计算CI会伪重复并夸大功效，必须按会话或注入实例聚类。反事实遮蔽也不是充分因果证据：删除chunk会改变检索排序、上下文长度和后续生成，δ后移及结局翻转可能来自分布扰动；且只重跑δ之后无法检验该chunk在δ之前的隐性影响。决定性实验应采用同rank等长良性替换、完整轨迹重放、多随机种子，并与随机替换比较翻转率。最后，40–60 GPU-hour只是断言；五臂、全局审计、候选级多次重放是否仍低于750小时需由pilot实测触发率与候选数后再确认。若要支持核心新颖性，CAMQ必须同时胜过MAPLE、disagreement及无δ的同规则引用基线，并用聚类CI报告效果。
evidence: A_auto中“逐字引用+第二代理引用+低信任”本身已是强过滤器；缺少移除δ定位但保留其余条件的基线，无法归因增益。
攻击事件共享会话状态、注入块和模型轨迹，不满足独立性；扩大名义N不能替代按会话/注入实例聚类的功效分析。
直接遮蔽会同时改变检索集合与提示分布；等rank、等长良性替换及多种子完整重放才可区分毒块因果效应与上下文扰动。
预算新增随机隔离主臂和候选级反事实重放，但40–60 GPU-hour未由候选数量、重放次数及触发率推导，750小时可行性仍未证实。

turns.claim:
三轮批评中最致命的一条我完全接受：若不设「无δ」的同规则基线，增益可能全部来自引用一致+低信任过滤。故改判据如下。

(1) 新增主实验必需臂 CiteTrust-only：仅用逐字引用一致 + provenance-trust 低于固定阈值触发隔离，不跑 LMAD、不用 δ 排序、不做局部辩论，与 CAMQ-full 构成单因素对照。核心判据升级为：CAMQ 须同时优于 MAPLE-Guard-only、MAPLE+disagreement-flag、CiteTrust-only、同率同rank同taint时长随机隔离四臂；对 CiteTrust-only 的配对差若 95% CI 下界≤0，直接书面结论为「δ 定位无增量价值」，不得改用其他指标救场。

(2) 统计按注入实例聚类。配对单位仍是攻击事件，但检验与区间一律用 cluster bootstrap（按 session×injected chunk 聚类，1000 次重抽），并强制报告 ICC、设计效应 DEFF 与有效样本量 N_eff。功效分析由 pilot 实测不一致对率与 ICC 推导；若 N_eff 对 2pp 达不到 80% 功效，预注册改为区间三分结论（优越/不确定/劣化），禁止宣称阈值通过。

(3) 反事实规范重写：放弃删除式遮蔽。改为同 rank、同长度良性替换（同会话内检索到的良性 chunk 或保留话题与长度的中性改写），从会话首轮完整重放、不复用 δ 后缓存、3 个随机种子。真正例须满足 δ 消失或后移且攻击结局翻转在≥2/3 种子成立，且相对「随机等 rank 良性替换」的翻转率配对差 CI 下界>0；并设高效用良性对照，其翻转率须不高于随机替换。

(4) 预算不再靠断言。写成 C_replay = n_cand × 3 seeds × 平均会话 token × c_token，全部参数由 50 会话 pilot 实测 d、n_cand/会话、会话长度后外推。预注册退让顺序：先砍 AppWorld 两臂 → 再砍 100 会话消融 → 主实验 500 降至 350 会话 → 最后才把种子 3 降到 2；四条基线臂与聚类 CI 不可砍。外推>750 GPU-hour 即不解锁主实验。

承认的弱点：若 CiteTrust-only 已拿到大部分 ASR 下降，CAMQ 新颖性归零，我方接受该阴性结论；全轨迹多种子重放使因果核验成为成本主导项，很可能被迫降到 350 会话，功效随之下降而只能报区间；A_auto 结构上只覆盖显式复述型攻击，静默共识失败与工具侧绕过文本记忆的攻击明确不在射程；R_glob≥0.30 意味多数毒块仍无法定位。
evidence: CiteTrust-only 与 CAMQ-full 之间只差「δ 排序 + 一轮局部辩论」一个因子，其余（逐字引用绑定、第二见证、provenance 阈值、隔离动作、taint 时长）完全相同，构成可判定的单因素消融；这正是二轮批评指出的缺失对照。
攻击事件在同一注入实例内共享会话状态与模型轨迹，ICC>0 时朴素 CI 低估方差、夸大功效；按 session×injected chunk 聚类重抽并公开 DEFF/N_eff，使「名义 N 膨胀」不可能被用来伪造显著性。
删除 chunk 会同时改变检索集合、上下文长度与后续生成分布；同 rank 同长度良性替换 + 全轨迹重放 + 多种子 + 随机替换对照，才能把毒块因果效应与分布扰动分离，且良性对照给出假阳性上界。
成本以公式而非断言给出：n_cand、d、会话长度均由 pilot 实测后代入 C_replay，并预注册固定退让顺序，保证 750 GPU-hour 硬顶下优先牺牲外部效度（AppWorld、样本量）而非内部效度（基线臂、聚类推断）。

turns.claim: 修订仍不能把收益归因于“最早冲突定位”。CiteTrust-only 与 CAMQ 同时相差δ排序和局部辩论，并非单因素对照；且若两臂触发集合或隔离率不同，差异还可能来自覆盖量。应做锁定同一分歧事件、候选集和隔离预算的2×2实验：有/无δ排序×有/无局部辩论，分别估计δ主效应与交互效应。统计上，session×chunk并非可靠独立簇：同一会话的多个注入块共享轨迹，应至少按session整簇重抽，或采用会话—chunk层级bootstrap；350–500会话对2pp差异大概率仍无80%功效。评价分母也需拆解：全部“插入毒块”含从未检索或未激活者，R_glob同时测检索暴露与定位能力；应预注册插入→检索→引用→冲突→归因的阶段召回，并保留静默成功率。另一个偏差是pilot以归因表现决定解锁：若50会话pilot被纳入最终500会话，确认性结果会条件化于幸运噪声。pilot必须与确认集隔离，或采用预注册顺序检验。决定性通过条件应是：独立确认集上，δ排序在2×2设计中的聚类CI下界>0，同时ASR改善不以MDSR、延迟或隔离率上升换取；否则贡献只能称为CiteTrust门控加辩论的工程组合。
evidence: CiteTrust-only到CAMQ同时新增δ排序与局部辩论，无法识别究竟哪个组件产生收益；2×2因子设计才可分离。
同一会话内不同chunk共享检索与生成状态，按session×chunk当独立簇仍会低估方差；应按session或层级重抽。
全插入毒块召回混合了“是否被检索”和“检索后能否归因”，阶段漏斗指标才能定位CAMQ真正能力。
用pilot效果门槛筛选并复用pilot样本会产生选择偏差；独立确认集或顺序设计是必要条件。

debate.consensus: After three rounds the two sides converged on a substantially narrower and more rigorous protocol than the original proposal, and the surviving disagreements are about attribution of credit and statistical power, not about whether the experiment is worth running. Agreed points: (1) the defense loop must be fully automatic — the online adjudicator A_auto (verbatim citation span binding to a chunk_id, an independent second-agent witness prefix citing the same chunk, and MAPLE provenance-trust below the paper-fixed threshold) is the only quarantine trigger, and human adjudication is demoted to offline label quality checking with kappa reported separately, so no defense number can depend on an oracle. (2) Cosine similarity and co-occurrence are candidate-generation signals only and never attribution evidence. (3) The headline attribution metric cannot be conditioned on disagreement occurring; the program now pre-registers a staged funnel (inserted -> retrieved -> cited -> conflict-triggering -> attributed) with global recall R_glob >= 0.30 and an explicitly reported silent-consensus rate counted as attribution failure, which is an honest admission that CAMQ structurally cannot cover no-disagreement covert failures. (4) Causal claims require same-rank, same-length benign substitution with full-trajectory replay across three seeds and a random-substitution plus high-utility-benign control, not deletion masking. (5) The skeptic's decisive round-3 objection is accepted: CiteTrust-only differs from CAMQ-full by two factors, so the core novelty claim (that earliest-conflict localization adds value) can only be tested by a 2x2 factorial over delta-ranking and localized debate, evaluated on a locked shared pool of disagreement events with matched candidate sets and matched quarantine budget so that gains cannot come from differing coverage or exposure reduction. (6) Inference must be clustered at the session level (or hierarchically session -> chunk), with ICC, DEFF and N_eff published, and a pre-registered three-way conclusion (superior / indeterminate / degraded) replacing any point-estimate threshold test. (7) The pilot must be held out from the confirmation split to avoid selection bias, and the compute budget must be derived from a pilot-measured formula with a fixed concession ladder that sacrifices external validity (AppWorld, session count, ablation slice) before internal validity (baseline arms, clustered inference, causal replay). The program is approved on this revised form because it is genuinely falsifiable in the strong sense: the pre-registered failure condition — if the delta-ranking main effect has a clustered CI lower bound at or below zero, the written conclusion is that earliest-conflict localization has no incremental value — is one the advocate has explicitly accepted, and either outcome is informative for memory-defense research. Novelty remains modest and incremental (a heuristic fusion of LMAD localization with MAPLE-Guard lifecycle gating), and feasibility is now the binding constraint: multi-seed full-trajectory counterfactual replay is the cost-dominant term and will likely force the confirmation split down to 350 sessions with interval-only reporting. Both are accepted as declared limitations rather than hidden risks, and the pilot gate plus hard 750 GPU-hour stop makes an unaffordable run terminate before it starts.
unresolvedQuestions: Statistical power is not resolved: even at 350-500 sessions with session-level clustering, a 2-3pp ASR@3 difference and especially the delta-ranking main effect in the 2x2 may only support an indeterminate interval, so the study may end without discriminating a real small effect from noise.

Whether same-rank, same-length benign substitution truly isolates the poison chunk's causal effect is still contested: substitution changes downstream generation distribution, and no design fully rules out that delta shifting and outcome flipping reflect prompt perturbation rather than the chunk's causal role.

Whether CiteTrust-only already captures most of the ASR reduction is unknown until run; if it does, CAMQ's contribution collapses to an engineering combination and the novelty score should retrospectively be 2.
The size of the ICC within session x injected-chunk clusters is unmeasured, so N_eff and therefore the entire power calculation remain pilot-dependent.

The replay cost parameters (candidate count per session, disagreement rate, mean session token length) are unmeasured; whether the eight-condition logical design compressed onto shared logged traces actually fits under 750 GPU-hours is an open empirical question the pilot must answer.

Coverage of the threat model is admittedly partial: silent-consensus poisoning, forged provenance lineage, and tool-side attacks that bypass retrieved textual memory are out of scope, and it is unresolved what fraction of realistic attacks those account for.
Whether attribution behavior on Qwen2.5-14B transfers across backbones is untested now that the cross-backbone slice is first on the concession ladder.

Whether an ASR gain accompanied by higher quarantine rate or added latency should count as success is specified only as a non-inferiority guardrail, and the acceptable latency ceiling for long-horizon sessions is not derived from any deployment requirement.

finalIdea.title: Conflict-Attributed Memory Quarantine (CAMQ): A Factorial Test of Earliest-Reasoning-Conflict Localization for Retrieve-Time Memory Poisoning Defense
finalIdea.hypothesis: On a held-out 350-session (target 500 if budget permits) stratified confirmation split of LongMemEval-MemoryGraft, disjoint from the pilot split, with quarantine triggered only by the fully automatic adjudicator A_auto: (i) staged attribution funnel yields global recall R_glob >= 0.30 of all injected poison chunks and precision >= 0.60 among adjudicated attributions, with session-clustered bootstrap 95% CI lower bounds >= 0.22 recall and >= 0.50 precision; (ii) in a 2x2 factorial over delta-ranking (on/off) and one localized debate round (on/off), evaluated on a locked shared pool of disagreement events with matched candidate sets and matched quarantine budget, the delta-ranking main effect on ASR@3 has a session-clustered 95% CI lower bound > 0; (iii) CAMQ-full reduces ASR@3 versus MAPLE-Guard-only with clustered CI lower bound > 0 while MDSR@3 drops by no more than 5 absolute points and quarantine rate and end-to-end latency do not exceed the rate-matched random-quarantine control; (iv) CAMQ-full also exceeds MAPLE-plus-disagreement-flag and CiteTrust-only. If the delta-ranking main-effect CI lower bound is <= 0, the pre-registered written conclusion is that earliest-reasoning-conflict localization provides no incremental value over verbatim-citation-plus-provenance gating, with no substitution of alternative metrics.
finalIdea.motivation: MAPLE-Guard reduces ASR on memory-graft and app-poisoning attacks but leaves retrieve-time latent harm, trades against MDSR, and offers no reasoning-time signal identifying which retrieved item to isolate. LMAD shows multi-agent failures originate at the earliest divergent intermediate claim and propagate downstream, so answer-level or write-time guards cannot pinpoint that locus. Three rounds of adversarial review reshaped the design: human adjudication inside the defense loop made the mechanism undeployable and leaked labels, so adjudication is now fully automatic; disagreement-conditioned recall flattered the method, so attribution is now measured as a staged funnel over all injected chunks with silent-consensus failures counted against the method; deletion-based masking confounded chunk causality with context perturbation, so counterfactuals now use same-rank same-length benign substitution with full-trajectory multi-seed replay; and, decisively, a CiteTrust-only baseline differing from CAMQ by two factors could not attribute gains to conflict localization, so the core claim is now tested by a 2x2 factorial isolating the delta-ranking main effect. Cost is no longer asserted but derived from a pilot-measured formula behind a hard gate.
method: Run a mandatory 50-session stratified pilot on LongMemEval-MemoryGraft with Qwen2.5-14B that is permanently disjoint from the confirmation split; the pilot measures disagreement rate d, candidates per session n_cand, mean session token length, A_auto trigger rate, and the intra-cluster correlation of attack outcomes within session x injected-chunk, and its sessions are never reused in any confirmation analysis.

Gate the confirmation run on the pilot: unlock only if pilot A_auto precision >= 0.55, pilot stage-conditional recall (attributed given retrieved and cited) >= 0.40, and the instantiated cost formula C_total = C_arms + C_replay, with C_replay = n_cand x 3 seeds x mean session tokens x c_token, projects <= 750 GPU-hours including audit and replay reruns; otherwise the confirmation run is not started and the pilot is reported as a negative feasibility result.

Deploy the 3-agent persistent-memory stack on LongMemEval-MemoryGraft with Qwen2.5-14B served by vLLM on <= 8 H100 GPUs, temperature schedule 0.1/0.5/0.9 for debating agents and temperature 0 for all auxiliary extractors, locators, and parsers, all with fixed seeds and immutable logs.

At retrieve time log immutable (query, chunk_id, rank, session, turn) tuples; bind reasoning atoms to memory exclusively through verbatim citation spans. Cosine >= 0.85 matches against the last k=5 retrieved chunks generate candidates only and never constitute attribution evidence.

Trigger the online adjudicator A_auto only on answer or proposed-tool-action disagreement, and quarantine a chunk_id only when all three conditions hold: a verbatim citation span binds a reasoning atom to that chunk_id, a second agent's witness prefix S_j independently cites the same chunk_id, and that chunk's MAPLE provenance-trust falls below the paper-fixed threshold. Human adjudication is excluded from the defense loop entirely and used only for offline label quality, reported as A_auto-versus-human agreement with kappa >= 0.7 as the label-quality target; every defense number cites A_auto alone.

Quarantine action is fixed and identical across all arms that quarantine: block shared promotion, set the taint flag, and exclude the chunk from top-m retrieval for a fixed number of subsequent rounds, leaving MAPLE write/retrieve/promotion/reuse gates unchanged.

Run the primary comparison as a locked five-condition set plus a 2x2 factorial: no defense; MAPLE-Guard-only with paper-fixed thresholds; MAPLE-plus-disagreement-flag (logs disagreements, never quarantines); rate-matched random quarantine with matched rank distribution and matched taint duration; and the 2x2 cells CiteTrust-only (no delta-ranking, no debate), CiteTrust+delta-ranking, CiteTrust+localized debate, and CAMQ-full (delta-ranking plus one localized debate round on S_i). The four factorial cells operate on the same locked pool of logged disagreement events, the same generated candidate sets, and the same per-session quarantine budget, so that neither trigger coverage nor retrieval-exposure reduction can differ between cells; shared trace prefixes are reused across cells to keep the factorial affordable.

Validate causality with counterfactual replay for each attributed candidate: replace the chunk with a same-rank, same-length benign chunk (a benign chunk retrieved in the same session, or a topic- and length-preserving neutral rewrite), replay the full session trajectory from the first turn without reusing post-delta cache, across 3 seeds. Count a true positive only when delta disappears or moves later and the attack outcome flips in at least 2 of 3 seeds, and when the paired flip-rate difference versus random same-rank benign substitution has a clustered CI lower bound > 0. Include a high-utility benign control whose flip rate must not exceed the random-substitution flip rate, giving an explicit false-positive upper bound.

Report attribution as a staged funnel rather than a single number: injected -> retrieved -> cited -> conflict-triggering -> A_auto-attributed -> causally confirmed, with the silent-consensus rate (attack succeeds and all agents agree) reported separately and counted as attribution failure in the R_glob denominator, never excluded.

Perform all hypothesis tests and intervals with hierarchical cluster bootstrap resampling whole sessions and then injected chunks within session (1000 resamples), publishing ICC, design effect, and effective sample size; pre-register the three-way conclusion (superior when the paired-difference CI lower bound > 0, indeterminate, degraded) and forbid reading a non-significant interval as evidence of no incremental value or as evidence of parity.

Cap cost with disagreement-triggered LMAD rather than per-step invocation, a 10-iteration LMAD maximum, exactly one localized debate round, and a hard stop at 750 GPU-hours; execute the pre-registered concession ladder in fixed order when projections exceed budget: drop AppWorld-AgentPoison, then drop the 100-session ablation slice, then reduce the confirmation split from 500 to 350 sessions, then reduce replay seeds from 3 to 2. The five primary conditions, the 2x2 factorial, clustered inference, and the pilot/confirmation split separation are never cut.
evaluation: Primary defense metrics: ASR@1/2/3 and MDSR@1/2/3 on the held-out LongMemEval-MemoryGraft confirmation split, mirroring MAPLE-Guard reporting and stratified by attack channel, with paired differences computed per attack event and inference by hierarchical session-level cluster bootstrap.

Primary novelty test: the delta-ranking main effect and the delta x debate interaction estimated from the 2x2 factorial on the locked shared conflict-event pool with matched candidate sets and matched quarantine budget; the delta main-effect clustered CI lower bound > 0 is the sole decisive criterion for claiming that earliest-conflict localization adds value.

Attribution validity: staged funnel rates (injected -> retrieved -> cited -> conflict -> attributed -> causally confirmed) with R_glob >= 0.30 and adjudicated precision >= 0.60, clustered CI lower bounds >= 0.22 and >= 0.50 respectively, plus the separately reported silent-consensus rate; conditional recall given disagreement is reported as a diagnostic only and never as a headline result.

Label-quality reporting: A_auto versus offline human labels on 200 stratified conflict events, reported as agreement and kappa; these human labels never enter any defense metric or any quarantine decision.

Causal controls: flip rates under attributed-chunk benign substitution, random same-rank benign substitution, and high-utility benign substitution, all with full-trajectory multi-seed replay, reported as paired differences with clustered intervals.

Non-inferiority guardrails reported alongside every ASR claim: MDSR@3 drop <= 5 points, quarantine rate no higher than the rate-matched random control, and end-to-end latency plus retrieval-call count versus MAPLE-Guard-only; an ASR gain purchased by higher quarantine rate, MDSR loss, or latency blowup is reported as a failed claim.
Pilot report published regardless of outcome: disagreement rate, candidates per session, ICC and effective sample size, instantiated cost formula, and the resulting unlock or no-unlock decision.

External validity, explicitly optional and first on the concession ladder: AppWorld-AgentPoison on MAPLE-Guard-only and CAMQ-full only, reported separately and never pooled with LongMemEval; a 50-session Gemma3-12B cross-backbone attribution-stability slice only if the primary run finishes under budget.
finalIdea.expectedContribution: The first falsifiable, factorially identified test of whether earliest-reasoning-conflict localization carries incremental retrieve-time signal for memory-chain poisoning beyond verbatim-citation-plus-provenance gating, delivered with a fully automatic adjudicator that keeps human labels out of the defense loop, a staged attribution funnel that counts silent-consensus failures against the method, same-rank benign-substitution counterfactuals with random and high-utility controls that separate causal effect from context perturbation, session-clustered inference with published ICC and effective sample size, and a pilot-derived cost model with a pre-registered concession ladder that protects internal validity under a 750 GPU-hour hard cap.
finalIdea.impactAssessment: A confirmed delta-ranking main effect would establish reasoning-conflict localization as a deployable retrieve-time isolation signal, lowering latent memory-graft ASR where rule-only lifecycle guards underperform, at inference-time engineering cost with no training. A null or indeterminate delta effect with a strong CiteTrust-only baseline would be equally valuable: it would redirect memory-defense research away from reasoning-conflict heuristics toward citation-provenance integrity, content models, and metadata authentication, and would document quantitatively how much of the apparent benefit of conflict-based defenses is really citation-and-trust filtering.
finalIdea.noveltyAssessment: Moderate to low and openly incremental: witness-to-memory attribution is a heuristic fusion of LMAD localized debate with MAPLE-Guard lifecycle enforcement rather than a new security primitive. The genuinely new elements are the factorial identification of the delta-localization component against a same-rule CiteTrust-only baseline, the automatic three-condition binding protocol, the staged funnel attribution metric, and the counterfactual substitution criterion. If CiteTrust-only captures most of the ASR reduction, the novelty of this work reduces to the negative result and the measurement protocol, an outcome the proposal accepts in advance.
finalIdea.resourceAssessment: Inference-only with no fine-tuning: vLLM-served Qwen2.5-14B on <= 8 H100 GPUs, well under the 8 x 7 x 24 = 1344 GPU-hour envelope, with a self-imposed 750 GPU-hour hard stop. Multi-seed full-trajectory counterfactual replay is the cost-dominant term and is the reason the confirmation split may land at 350 rather than 500 sessions; the 2x2 factorial is made affordable by sharing logged trace prefixes and a single locked conflict-event pool across cells rather than running independent full sweeps. All cost estimates are pilot-instantiated through C_replay = n_cand x 3 seeds x mean session tokens x c_token, and the run does not start if projections exceed the cap.
finalIdea.trainingResources: None. CAMQ is an inference-time protocol over frozen LLM backbones plus deterministic extractors, locators, parsers, and fixed-threshold MAPLE-Guard provenance scoring.
risks: CiteTrust-only may capture most of the ASR reduction, giving a delta-ranking main effect whose clustered CI lower bound is <= 0 and reducing the contribution to a negative result plus measurement protocol.
Even at 350-500 sessions with session-level clustering, effective sample size may be too small to resolve a 2-3pp effect, leaving the primary comparisons in the pre-registered indeterminate band.

Same-rank benign substitution still perturbs downstream generation, so outcome flips may partly reflect distributional disturbance rather than the poison chunk's causal role; the random and high-utility controls bound but do not eliminate this.
Atomic-chain extraction on a 14B backbone may be too noisy for reliable delta localization, collapsing funnel recall below R_glob 0.30 even after the pilot gate.
A_auto's three-condition conjunction structurally covers only explicit-restatement attacks; silent-consensus poisoning is counted as failure by design and remains uncovered.
Provenance metadata is assumed honest; forged chunk lineage bypasses the trust condition and therefore the entire quarantine trigger.
Tool-centric InjectAgent-style attacks that bypass retrieved textual memory are out of scope, and the AppWorld slice is exploratory, two-arm, and first to be cut under budget pressure.
Multi-seed full-trajectory replay may dominate cost enough to force the concession ladder down to 350 sessions and 2 seeds, weakening both power and causal confirmation strength.
Disagreement-triggered LMAD plus a localized debate round may push end-to-end latency past practical deployment limits on long-horizon sessions even while staying inside the GPU-hour cap.

idea.title: TouchGround-Edge: Isolating Gated Tactile Foresight from Edge Semantic Distillation in Delayed Cloud-Edge VLA Control for Contact-Rich Manipulation
idea.hypothesis: Under wall-clock-faithful delay injection at d_max=10 control steps, adding rate-budgeted blocking tactile-foresight refinement (Foresight Action Expert refined at offsets 4/8/12, gated by a frozen causal contact-intensity estimator) on top of an edge baseline that already includes a language-conditioned proxy head reconstructing the fresh cloud feature raises macro-averaged success on four contact-rich XHT tasks by ≥5 percentage points, with paired bootstrap 95% confidence intervals excluding zero on ≥400 closed-loop simulation rollouts per condition; the increment grows with delay and with causal contact-change intensity (significant delay×intensity interaction in a mixed-effects model), exceeds a trigger-rate-matched random gate, exceeds an equal-duration no-op blocking arm and a compute-matched non-foresight refinement head, and accounts for ≥70% of its gain through reduction of contact-class failures. If the increment is absent or does not exceed the rate-matched and compute-matched controls, the semantic-grounding narrative is withdrawn and the reported conclusion is that edge semantic distillation, not tactile foresight, compensates cloud staleness.
idea.motivation: CloudEdgeVLA shows stale cloud semantics plus fresh local vision can preserve manipulation under network delay, but its evaluation is dominated by pick-and-place where contact dynamics are secondary. ReTouch shows contact state evolves faster than a fixed action block and that blocking refinement of tactile predictions improves dexterous success. The open question is whether tactile foresight is a genuinely distinct fast loop or merely a stand-in for refreshing stale visual semantics at the edge. Three rounds of adversarial review established that this question cannot be answered by comparing a full system against a stale-feature baseline: an edge head that sees current RGB and the language instruction can repair semantic staleness on its own, an online gate defined over future contact change leaks its own label, a learned discrete trigger threshold has no gradient, and delay measured in control steps hides the wall-clock cost of blocking. This proposal therefore reframes the study as a factorial isolation of the tactile-foresight contribution inside a real-time-faithful delay harness, with the gate treated as a testable timing mechanism rather than an assumed benefit.
method: Retain the async split: a frozen cloud OpenVLA-OFT LoRA encodes delayed (o_{t-d}, language) into h; the edge runs frozen SigLIP on current RGB and a frozen tactile-patch encoder over a 10-frame tactile history; the edge never blocks on the cloud and always consumes the most recently received h.

Edge cloud-proxy head P (≤5M parameters, <2ms): a 2-layer MLP mapping current z_t, the cached per-episode language embedding, and (in the foresight-enabled arms) the FAE tactile latent to an estimate of the fresh cloud feature, supervised by cosine plus L1 against Phase-A-cached h_fresh. Fusion uses h′=(1−g)·h+g·ĥ_e. Because P is language-conditioned it is explicitly reported as lightweight cloud-feature distillation, with parameters and latency itemized separately, not as a zero-cost mechanism.

Foresight Action Expert (FAE) on the edge predicts a 16-step future tactile latent and action suffix from current edge observations; when triggered, it recursively refines the future tactile latent with the newest tactile feedback and regenerates the remaining action suffix (ReTouch-style blocking refinement) under a ≤35ms wall-clock cap, with fallback to the existing one-shot suffix if the cap is exceeded.

Causal contact-intensity estimator ĉ_t: computed only from tactile-embedding change rates over frames strictly before t plus past force magnitude and an online stage posterior estimated from past observations; residualized against deployment-available covariates only (no ground-truth stage, no future force). ĉ_t is trained separately on a disjoint task subset, frozen before Phase B, and validated on unseen tasks against the oracle future-block intensity (go/no-go: Spearman ρ≥0.3 and high-tercile AUC≥0.65). The oracle-gated variant C_oracle is run only as a reported observability ceiling.

Staleness-Contact Gating (SCG): continuous gate g=σ(w·[ĉ_t, s, ĉ_t·s]+b) with s=d/d_max, trained end-to-end and used for both fusion blending and the tactile blend T′=(1−g)·T_curr+g·T_fae. Discrete refinement triggering uses straight-through Gumbel-sigmoid; the threshold is not learned but set by budget quantile, with the trigger rate constrained by a Lagrangian term to targets ρ∈{10%,25%,40%} swept as a hyperparameter, and the former hard sparsity penalty replaced by the relaxed E[σ(·)] form to remove zero gradients.
Fuse h′, z_t, and T′ through a Vision-Augmented Action Head producing 16-step continuous actions via flow matching (10-step Euler inference).

Real-time scheduling simulator: wall-clock accounting for cloud round-trip with jitter, edge inference cost, and blocking-refinement pauses, during which the contact simulation continues to advance. Component latencies are calibrated against timestamps recorded on the physical XHand–UR7e stack. Control-step-only delay injection is retained solely as a legacy sanity check, never as a primary endpoint.

Training budget (≤8×H100×7d, with evaluation compute explicitly budgeted): Phase A (≤1d) precompute h_fresh and h_stale for all XHT windows at d~Uniform(1,d_max) and pre-train/freeze ĉ_t on the disjoint subset; Phase B (≤3.5d) train FAE, proxy head P, SCG parameters, fusion head, and tactile-to-action adapters for ≤20k updates (global batch 8, bf16, AdamW 2.5e-5→2.5e-6, 1k warmup, clip 1.0) with dual-path loss L=(1−λ)||â_fresh−a_t||₁+λ||â_stale−a_t||₁ on cached h, proxy-reconstruction loss, FAE–HAE cosine alignment (0.1), and the relaxed trigger-rate term; Phase C (≤1.5d) closed-loop evaluation and identification controls; ≤1d buffer. No live 7B forwards during Phase B.

Pre-registered factorial ablation (primary): 2×2 over proxy head P {off, on} × FAE gated refinement {off, on}, i.e. A = stale h only, B = P only, C = FAE only, D = P + gated FAE. The primary endpoint is the FAE main effect and its interaction with delay and causal contact intensity, evaluated against B as the reference baseline rather than against A. A z_t+language-only proxy variant (no FAE latent input) is included to prevent the proxy head from absorbing foresight credit.

Pre-registered identification controls, all inference-time interventions requiring no retraining: trigger-rate-matched random gate R at each ρ; equal-duration no-op blocking arm; compute-matched non-foresight refinement head; shuffled-h and shuffled-ĉ_t; temporally misaligned tactile input; and exogenous clamping of g to fixed quantiles {0.1,0.5,0.9} crossed 2×2 with h/shuffled-h under matched initial states and paired seeds, so that cloud-dependence claims rest on randomized rather than model-selected gate values.

Simulation credibility gate (three-part, pre-registered): TOST equivalence on normal force and slip-onset timing with bounds derived from measured sensor noise and task tolerance (not arbitrary thresholds); multi-step divergence bounds at 4/8/16 steps evaluated on states induced by the trained policy itself, not only on replay of recorded behavior-policy actions; and condition-B sim-versus-real success difference ≤10pp. Sample size is set by power analysis on existing XHT real trajectories, expanding from 100 to 200 if needed, with no new teleoperation. If any part fails, the closed-loop sim endpoint is demoted to mechanism diagnostics and the hypothesis is reported as undecided within this budget.

Secondary real-robot confirmation, honestly de-powered: 2 tasks × 60 rollouts × conditions B and D at d_max=10 (120 rollouts) on XHand–UR7e with recorded timestamps, reported as directional confirmation with its ~10pp minimum detectable effect stated; the remaining two tasks receive a small pre-registered direction-consistency check only.

Release the causal contact-intensity splits, the real-time delay-and-blocking harness, gate parameters, and all identification-control scripts; the default tactile encoder is π₀+tactile fine-tuned 5k steps on XHT patches, with a ReTouch-initialized arm as a sensitivity check only.
evaluation: Primary (closed-loop simulation, wall-clock faithful): four contact-rich XHT tasks (Pipette Press, Bottle Grasp, Cob Grasp, Sponge Wipe), ≥400 paired rollouts per condition at d_max=10 with fixed initial states, paired seeds, and frozen policies; report the 2×2 factorial with macro-average success, paired bootstrap 95% CIs, and a pre-specified ≥5pp superiority margin for the FAE increment over the proxy-only baseline B. The margin is a superiority test with a minimum effect size, not a non-inferiority test.

Mechanism identification: FAE increment stratified by causal contact intensity and by delay, with a mixed-effects delay×intensity interaction test; D versus rate-matched R at each ρ∈{10%,25%,40%}; D versus equal-duration no-op blocking and versus the compute-matched non-foresight head; contact-class failure decomposition requiring ≥70% of the gain to come from contact failures.

Gate validity and cost of observability: ĉ_t predictive validity on unseen tasks (Spearman ρ, high-tercile AUC), gap between D and D_oracle, realized trigger rate versus target, mean and tail blocking time, and collapse detection against the always-refine arm.

Cloud-dependence test under randomization: exogenously clamped g ∈ {0.1,0.5,0.9} crossed with h versus shuffled-h at matched states; a real reduction in the low-g cells with no reduction in the high-g cells is required to claim that gating modulates reliance on cloud semantics.

Proxy-head go/no-go: same-scene instruction swap at identical initial states; if ĥ_e output cosine changes by <0.05 or high-g success degrades to instruction-independent levels, the proxy head is judged to have failed and the cloud-semantic-grounding claim is withdrawn entirely, retaining only tactile conditional-computation conclusions.

Simulation calibration report: TOST outcomes with noise-and-tolerance-justified bounds, policy-induced-state divergence at 4/8/16 steps, and the condition-B sim-to-real success gap, published before primary unblinding.

Latency sweep and OOD (sim only): delay AUC for D versus B at d_max∈{0,5,10,20} (200 rollouts) and ReTouch challenge variants (sponge height change, cob position offset) at d_max=10 with ≥20 rollouts per variant.

Contact-specific diagnostics on 100 held-out trajectories (open-loop, diagnostic only): future tactile latent cosine similarity and action-suffix MSE at offsets 4/8/12 comparing one-shot, gated, and always-refine refinement.

Real-robot secondary: 120 rollouts (2 tasks × 60, conditions B and D) with recorded wall-clock timestamps; report sim-to-real gap and directional agreement, with the underpowering stated explicitly rather than treated as confirmation.
idea.expectedContribution: A factorial isolation of blocking tactile foresight from edge semantic distillation under network delay, evaluated in a wall-clock-faithful cloud-edge harness with pre-registered identification controls. Concretely: (i) a causal, deployment-available contact-intensity estimator with released splits and an oracle-gap measurement of its observability cost; (ii) a rate-budgeted straight-through gating mechanism whose timing information content is testable against a rate-matched random gate; (iii) a real-time delay-and-blocking simulator with equivalence-tested and policy-induced-state calibration, including equal-duration no-op and compute-matched controls that most prior blocking-refinement results lack; and (iv) a pre-committed decision rule that maps every outcome to an honest claim, from 'gated tactile foresight grounds delayed cloud semantics' down to 'edge semantic distillation plus conditional computation explains the gains'.
idea.impactAssessment: Moderate. The engineering question—when a delayed cloud VLA needs a local tactile fast loop, and whether paying a blocking pause is worth it—is directly relevant to mobile manipulators that offload large models, and the rate-budgeted trigger gives a deployable knob. The harness and controls are reusable beyond this system and correct a recurring measurement flaw, since benefits of blocking refinement are routinely reported without accounting for wall-clock pauses or matched compute. Impact is bounded by the single platform, dense-tactile requirement, four tasks, and 800 demonstrations, and by the real possibility that the honest answer is negative or undecided. A clean negative result that attributes gains to edge distillation rather than tactile foresight is still useful, because it redirects effort from tactile prediction toward cheap semantic caching at the edge.
idea.noveltyAssessment: Moderate. The architecture is composed from existing parts: CloudEdgeVLA-style dual-path stale-feature training, ReTouch-style blocking tactile refinement, standard conditional-computation gating, and a small distillation head. The advocate conceded that the language-conditioned proxy head is cloud-feature distillation, so no novel module is claimed. Remaining novelty lies in the causal latency×contact coupling diagnostic, the rate-budgeted gating formulation whose collapse is measurable rather than assumed away, the real-time blocking-aware evaluation harness with equal-duration no-op and compute-matched controls, and the factorial protocol that separates foresight from semantic refresh. This is methodological and empirical novelty rather than architectural novelty, and it is stated as such.
idea.resourceAssessment: Feasible but tight, and only after explicitly budgeting evaluation. 8×H100 for 7 days (~1,344 GPU-hours), allocated as: Phase A ≤1d (offline h_fresh/h_stale cache plus independent training and freezing of ĉ_t on a disjoint task subset), Phase B ≤3.5d (≤20k edge updates, reduced from 25k to fund evaluation), Phase C ≤1.5d closed-loop simulation with batched parallel environments and periodic frozen 7B cloud forwards on one GPU, ≤1d buffer. Every identification control is an inference-time intervention needing no retraining, which is what keeps the expanded protocol affordable; the binding constraint is closed-loop rollout throughput, roughly 4,000 total rollouts across the factorial, controls, sweep, and OOD variants. No new teleoperation: XHT-Dataset (800 train / 100 held-out) is reused, one task reserved for validation monitoring, one disjoint subset reserved for the gate estimator. Real-robot cost drops to 120 rollouts plus reuse of existing trajectories for calibration. Deployment inference matches the disclosed split: cloud 7B on one GPU, edge SigLIP + FAE + proxy head + gate on RTX-class hardware under a ≤35ms refinement cap.
idea.trainingResources: 8× NVIDIA H100, 7 calendar days, bf16 mixed precision. Phase A ≤1d for the h cache and independent contact-intensity estimator; Phase B ≤3.5d for ≤20k edge policy updates covering FAE, the ≤5M-parameter language-conditioned proxy head, SCG parameters, fusion head, and tactile adapters, at global batch size 8 with AdamW, gradient clip 1.0, 1,000-step warmup, cosine decay 2.5e-5→2.5e-6, straight-through Gumbel-sigmoid triggering with a Lagrangian rate constraint at ρ∈{10%,25%,40%}, and relaxed E[σ(·)] regularization; Phase C ≤1.5d reserved for closed-loop evaluation and identification controls; ≤1d buffer. Initialization from OpenVLA-OFT LoRA and π₀+tactile (5k XHT steps), with an optional ReTouch sensitivity arm. No live 7B forwards during Phase B, no 7B pretraining, no new data collection.
risks: The FAE increment over the proxy-only baseline B may be small or zero, meaning current-frame semantic refresh at the edge explains the original gains; the factorial is designed to expose this, and the pre-committed fallback is to report edge semantic distillation plus conditional computation as the finding.

Wall-clock-faithful blocking may erase the benefit: contact continues to evolve during the ≤35ms pause, and the equal-duration no-op arm may reveal that measured gains partly reflect pause-free baselines rather than better predictions.

The frozen causal contact-intensity estimator may fail its unseen-task validity gate, or may act only as a state-difficulty proxy, in which case gated refinement will not beat the rate-matched random gate and no timing mechanism can be claimed.

Simulation calibration may fail equivalence testing or policy-induced-state divergence bounds, especially for deformable and slip-dominated contacts, leaving the primary endpoint undecided within budget; the protocol commits to reporting 'undecided' rather than substituting weaker evidence.
The 120-rollout real-robot arm has roughly 10pp minimum detectable effect and cannot independently confirm a 5pp incremental effect, so external validity remains weakly established.

Closed-loop rollout throughput, not gradient updates, is the binding compute constraint; if simulation is slower than projected, the identification controls must be trimmed by a pre-registered priority order (rate-matched gate, no-op blocking, and compute-matched head are protected first).
The conjunctive verdict rule makes a fully positive result unlikely, and results may remain confined to four tasks on one hand-arm platform with dense tactile sensing, limiting generalization claims.
Contribution value depends on releasing the harness, splits, and control scripts; incomplete artifact release would leave little durable value if the mechanism result is negative.
