Default tactile encoder: π₀+tactile fine-tuned 5k steps on XHT patches; optional ReTouch-initialized arm as sensitivity check only.
Inject identical delay protocol at train and eval: sample d~Uniform(1,d_max) from trajectory history; primary evaluation via sim-replay with frozen policies.

Pre-registered ablations at d_max=10: (A) stale h+fresh z_t only, (B) +current tactile without FAE, (C) full TouchGround-Edge with SCG+FAE, (D) FAE without SCG, (E) full model without dual-path stale loss; ≥400 held-out sim-replay rollouts before targeted real-robot confirmation.
Secondary real-robot confirmation: 240 rollouts (30×4 tasks×2 conditions: A vs C) on XHand–UR7e at d_max=10; exploratory latency sweep d_max∈{5,20} on C vs A in sim-replay only (200 rollouts).
refinements.rationale: Round-3 closes remaining gaps: sim-replay-first pre-registration supplies adequate power without exceeding GPU budget, SCG plus LCCI provides a testable mechanism beyond CloudEdgeVLA+ReTouch composition, and the ablation ladder directly addresses gate-collapse and uniform-refinement alternatives. Core training and primary evaluation fit 8×H100×7 days with explicit Phase A/B caps; secondary real-robot rollouts are scoped as directional confirmation. Residual risks (800-demo overfitting, sim-to-real gap, multi-clause hypothesis) are acknowledged and mitigated by held-out task monitoring, C vs D diagnostics, and artifact release—acceptable at round 3 for a focused contact-rich cloud-edge contribution.

debate.topic: Whether gated edge tactile foresight (TouchGround-Edge with Staleness-Contact Gating) is the compensating fast loop that grounds stale cloud VLA semantics in contact-rich dexterous manipulation, under an 8×H100/7-day budget

turns.claim:
核心主张：该提案的可证伪性基本成立，但需以下四项收紧才能在既定预算内给出干净结论。

(1) 补一个关键对照 R（随机门控）：以与 SCG 相同的触发率、在随机控制步触发阻塞式精化。只有 C>R 才能证明"何时精化"携带信息；若 C≈R，说明起作用的只是精化次数，SCG 机制归零。R 在 sim-replay 中近乎零成本，应写入预注册消融梯（A/B/C/D/E + R）。

(2) 明确 sim-replay 语义。成功率端点必须是闭环仿真：从留出 XHT 片段的初始物体位姿与手部状态出发，策略冻结、注入同一延迟协议后自由推演；纯轨迹回放只用于 offsets 4/8/12 的触觉隐变量余弦与动作后缀 MSE 诊断。否则"在回放状态上打分"无法定义成功。

(3) 失败归因分层。每次 rollout 预注册标注为语义失败（抓错物体、阶段顺序错）或接触失败（滑移、掉落、力超限、姿态漂移）。机制性预测应写死：C 相对 A 的 ≥7pp 增益中 ≥70% 须来自接触失败的减少；若增益主要来自语义失败，即使总体 p<0.05 也判机制假设不成立。这把风险清单第 5 条从"可能失败"变为可测量。

(4) LCCI 的前置效度检验。LCCI 基于冻结触觉编码器、与策略无关，可离线计算；但用作门控特征前须先验证：在基线 A 上 LCCI 与接触失败率的 Spearman ρ≥0.3。不成立则耦合前提本身被证伪，应在 Phase B 前中止，而非事后解释。

让步（不辩护的部分）：新颖性有限，SCG 只是三个标量 (w,b,τ)，真正贡献是耦合诊断与基准，故 SCG 须对 D（always-refine）与 R 比较，而非只对 A 宣称胜利；真机 240 rollouts 严重欠功效（每任务 30 次，MDE 约 15–18pp，检不出 7pp），应降级为方向一致性检查，预注册"4 个任务中 ≥3 个符号一致"，不作显著性声明；原文把 ≥7pp 写成"非劣效边界"是术语错误，实为带最小效应量的优效性检验；时序须写明：20 Hz 控制下 1 步=50ms，d_max=10 即 500ms 陈旧度，35ms 阻塞上限占单步预算 70%，可行但紧，若实际控制频率更高该上限不成立，需重新标定。
evidence: 功效算术决定了 sim 主端点/真机次要确认的分工，而非便利选择：sim-replay 每条件 ≥400 rollouts（4 任务 ×≥100）在配对 bootstrap、α=0.05 下对 7pp 效应功效充足；真机每任务 30 次的 MDE 约 15–18pp，结构上无法检出 7pp。
两个来源工作的证据留下的正是待测交互项：CloudEdgeVLA 的评测由 pick-and-place 主导、接触动力学次要；ReTouch 表明块内接触状态演化快于固定动作块、一次性触觉预测会在块内失效。两者均未测"延迟语义 × 快速接触"，这正是 LCCI×staleness 门控新增的唯一自由度。
预算有余量吸收新增对照：Phase A 离线缓存 h_fresh/h_stale 消除 Phase B 的 7B 前向，边缘侧 ≤25k 更新（global batch 8, bf16）落在 8×H100×7d 内；新增的 R 对照与失败归因标注只消耗 sim rollouts 与标注工时，不增训练预算。
门控坍缩可事前检测而非事后辩解：预注册 g 激活率须落在 [0.15, 0.85]，越界即判机制无效并只报 D vs A；配合 0.05 稀疏惩罚与 D、R 两个对照，坍缩不会被误读为成功。

turns.claim: 当前方案尚不能支持“SCG grounding 延迟云语义”的机制结论。首要硬伤是 h′=(1−g)h+g·StopGrad(h)：前向恒等于 h；且云路径已冻结，反向也几乎无差别，因此 SCG 实际没有重加权云特征。T′门控和触发精化可能有效，但只能证明触觉计算调度，而非云—触觉融合。其次，硬阈值 1[g≥τ]、触发决策及“学习τ”不可微，未说明直通估计、软门控或强化学习，门控很可能只受 T′路径训练并坍缩。更根本的是“sim-replay success”定义含混：若策略动作不能改变后续状态，无法测闭环任务失败；若使用仿真器自由推演，则需证明其接触与触觉生成经过独立真机校准，不能称为普通 replay。LCCI 又由触觉变化定义，天然接近接触事件强度；其与改进相关不等于“延迟×接触耦合”，尤其 d 在区间内随机时可能主要由任务阶段混杂。决定性测试应为：修正为可观测的云门控（如 h′=(1−g)h 或双路注意力）后，加入匹配触发率的随机门控、仅LCCI、仅staleness、打乱LCCI及时序错位触觉对照；以闭环 rollout、固定初始状态和配对随机种子比较。机制成立须同时满足 C>A、C>随机门控、交互模型中的 LCCI×delay 项显著、接触失败下降主导，且在未参与门控训练的任务与真机上方向一致。否则最多说明阻塞式触觉精化有用，不能宣称SCG或语义grounding新颖性。
evidence: 代数上，(1−g)h+g·StopGrad(h) 的前向值始终为 h；冻结云编码器后 StopGrad 更不构成有效云权重控制。
硬阈值触发和指示函数稀疏惩罚对 τ、g 几乎处处零梯度；方案未给出可训练替代，所称“learned threshold”缺乏实现闭环。
离线轨迹回放中的动作不改变未来接触状态，因而不能识别成功率的因果变化；闭环接触仿真才可作为主端点，并需真机校准。
总体 C>A 无法区分SCG信息价值与更多精化计算；匹配触发率随机门控及二维因子消融是识别 LCCI×staleness 交互的必要对照。

turns.claim:
接受两处硬伤，修正后主张仍可证伪。

(1) 云门控代数确为空操作，撤回原式。改为 h′=(1−g)·h+g·ĥ_e，其中 ĥ_e 由边缘小头（2 层 MLP，≤5M 参）从 z_t 与触觉前瞻潜变量回归"当前时刻云特征"，以 Phase A 已缓存的 h_fresh 作监督（余弦+L1）。g→1 时云特征被边缘代理替换，前向可观测、梯度非零。配套预注册"云消融检验"：推理时把 h 换成同任务他条轨迹的 h（shuffled-h）。若低 g 段成功率显著下降而高 g 段不降，证明门控确在调节对云语义的依赖；若两段皆不降，则云路径无用，整条 grounding 叙事作废并如实报告。

(2) 不可微问题成立。拆成两件事：连续融合权重 g 用 sigmoid 直接可微训练；离散触发改用 straight-through Gumbel-sigmoid，τ 不再"学习"，改为按预算分位数设定，触发率经拉格朗日项约束到目标 ρ∈{10%,25%,40%} 作超参扫描；稀疏惩罚改为 E[σ(·)] 松弛式，消除零梯度。

(3) 主端点定义收紧为闭环仿真推演：固定初始状态、配对随机种子、注入同一延迟协议、策略冻结；开环回放只用于 offsets 4/8/12 的触觉隐变量余弦与动作后缀 MSE 诊断。前置门槛：接触仿真须先在 100 条真机轨迹上校准，法向力与滑移起始时刻分布 KS 检验 p>0.05，且条件 A 的 sim 与真机成功率差 ≤10pp；不通过则主端点降级为方向性证据。

(4) LCCI 混杂成立。改用残差 LCCI：对任务阶段 one-hot 与接触力幅值回归后取残差，仅以残差项做门控与相关性声明；并加 shuffled-LCCI 与时序错位触觉两个对照。

机制成立须同时满足：C>A（≥7pp）、C>R（速率匹配随机门控）、混合效应模型中 LCCI×d 交互项显著、接触类失败减少占总增益 ≥70%。任一不满足即只声明"阻塞式触觉精化有用"，不声明 SCG 或语义 grounding。

让步：≥7pp 是带最小效应量的优效性检验，原文"非劣效"是术语错误；真机 240 次欠功效，改为 2 个任务×60 次把 MDE 压到约 10pp，其余任务只作预注册的方向一致性检查。
evidence: 边缘代理头的监督信号已存在，不增预算：Phase A 已为每个 XHT 窗口缓存 h_fresh 与 h_stale，ĥ_e 的回归目标现成；≤5M 参数头落在 Phase B 的 25k 边缘更新内，仍不触碰冻结的 7B 云编码器。
shuffled-h、rate-matched R、shuffled-LCCI、时序错位触觉四个对照均为纯推理期干预，只消耗 sim rollouts 与标注工时，不需重训，因此可在 8×H100×7d 内全部预注册。
预算约束下的 straight-through 触发是条件计算中的成熟做法，并把坍缩变成可测量：ρ 被固定后，C 与 R 的差异只能来自"何时触发"的位置信息；C≈R 即判 SCG 机制归零。
功效算术支持这一分工：闭环 sim 每条件 ≥400 配对 rollouts 对 7pp 效应在 α=0.05 下功效充足；真机每任务 30 次 MDE 约 15–18pp，重配为 2 任务×60 次后约 10pp，仍不足以独立检验 7pp，故只作方向确认。

turns.claim: 修订仍有三项致命识别问题。第一，LCCI按“动作块内平均触觉变化”定义，在线决策时需要未来触觉，属于标签泄漏；残差化也未解决因果可用性，且若回归使用真实接触力或任务阶段，会引入部署时不可得信息。必须改成仅由t时刻以前窗口估计的因果LCCI，并单独报告其预测误差。第二，ĥ_e只输入当前视觉与触觉前瞻，不含语言，原则上无法重建指令条件的h_fresh；在同一场景多指令数据中会回归到平均语义。加入语言后又变成云表征蒸馏的新方法，改变了原“最小SCG”贡献及计算预算。第三，仿真校准门槛不成立：KS p>0.05只是未拒绝差异，不证明等价；边际力/滑移分布匹配也不能验证动作依赖的闭环接触转移。shuffled-h按高低g分层还受门控内生选择影响，不能单独证明语义替换。决定性测试应为：因果LCCI对照未来LCCI上界；同场景指令互换测试代理头；用预设等价界检验仿真多步转移；在固定g分位与匹配状态下做h替换。若因果LCCI、无语言代理或真机方向验证任一失败，应撤回“延迟云语义grounding”，最多保留触觉条件计算结论。
evidence: 未来块定义的LCCI在触发时不可观测；使用它会把未来接触剧烈程度直接泄漏给门控。
视觉和触觉不能区分“抓红瓶”与“抓蓝瓶”等同景异指令，故无语言ĥ_e无法一般性逼近语言条件云特征。
KS检验p>0.05不等于分布等价，100条轨迹对尾部滑移和闭环误差累积尤其缺乏排除能力。
按模型生成的g分层评估shuffled-h会混合状态难度、代理质量与云依赖；需固定状态匹配或随机干预g才能识别。

turns.claim:
三项质疑我接受两项半，修正后核心假设仍可证伪，但主张范围收窄。

(1) LCCI 泄漏成立，撤回原定义。门控只用因果 LCCI：ĉ_t 由 t 之前 10 帧触觉嵌入的变化率与 FAE 前瞻潜变量估计；残差化只对部署可得量（过去触觉力幅值、由过去观测在线估计的阶段后验）回归，不使用真值阶段或未来力。预注册效度门槛：ĉ_t 对未来块真实 LCCI 的 Spearman ρ≥0.3 且高分位分类 AUC≥0.65，在基线 A 上先验证，不达标则 Phase B 前中止。oracle LCCI 仅作性能上界对照 C_oracle，C 与 C_oracle 之差即门控可观测性代价，单独报告。

(2) 语言条件成立。ĥ_e 输入补入语言嵌入（每 episode 常量，随首条云消息到达后边缘缓存，不随 d 变陈旧），仍 ≤5M 参、<2ms。同景异指令互换设为 go/no-go：同一初始状态交换指令，若 ĥ_e 输出余弦变化 <0.05，或高 g 段成功率退化到指令无关水平，判代理头失效，g 只保留触觉路径 T′ 与触发调度，「云语义 grounding」主张整体撤回，仅声明触觉条件计算。让步：加语言后该头确属轻量云表征蒸馏，我不再称其为零新增机制，并按参数与时延单列成本。

(3) 校准门槛成立，改等价性检验而非「未拒绝」：法向力与滑移起始时刻用 TOST，边界预注册（力 ±0.5N、滑移起始 ±40ms）；另加动作依赖的多步转移检验——从匹配初始状态回放既有真机动作序列，比较 4/8/16 步触觉与位姿发散是否落在预设界内；再加条件 A 的 sim–真机成功率差 ≤10pp。三关任一不过，sim 端点降为机制诊断，主端点在本预算内判为「未决」，不改用弱证据补位。

(4) shuffled-h 的内生选择成立。改为随机干预：推理时以外生随机分配把 g 钳到预设分位 {0.1,0.5,0.9}，与 h/shuffled-h 交叉成 2×2，固定初始状态、配对种子；识别来自随机化的 g，而非模型自选的 g。

判决维持合取：C>A≥7pp、C>速率匹配 R、因果 LCCI×d 交互显著、接触类失败减少占增益≥70%、指令互换与等价性检验通过。任一不满足即只保留「阻塞式触觉精化与条件计算有用」。
evidence: 新增的全部识别性对照（速率匹配 R、shuffled-h、shuffled-LCCI、时序错位触觉、g 随机钳位 2×2、C_oracle 上界）均为纯推理期干预，不需重训，只消耗 sim rollouts 与标注工时，仍落在 8×H100×7d 与 25k 边缘更新内。
语言与视觉在本设置中的延迟结构不同：指令是 per-episode 常量，一次传输即可边缘缓存；真正随 d 变陈旧的是视觉条件的 h。因此补语言不改变延迟建模，也不需要云侧新前向，只增 ≤5M 参数、<2ms。
等价性检验用的是 XHT 已有真机轨迹，无新采集；预注册界与所需样本量一并公布，若 100 条不足以在给定界内达 80% 功效则扩至 200 条，仍不触发新的遥操作预算。
功效算术支撑「未决」而非降标准：闭环 sim 每条件 ≥400 配对 rollouts 对 7pp 效应在 α=0.05 下功效充足；真机重配为 2 任务×60 次后 MDE 约 10pp，只能作方向确认，故 sim 校准三关不过时本假设无法在预算内被判定。

turns.claim: 修订解决了明显泄漏，却仍不足以识别“触觉前瞻 grounding 延迟云语义”。首先，ĥ_e 同时利用当前视觉、语言和 FAE 潜变量回归 h_fresh，本身就是一个边缘语义蒸馏器；C>A 的增益可能完全来自用当前视觉替换陈旧视觉，而非触觉前瞻。必须做 2×2 因子实验：代理替换开/关×FAE 开/关，并加入仅由 z_t+语言预测 ĥ_e 的代理；只有 FAE 的增量效应随 delay×因果LCCI 增强，才能支持核心叙事。其次，ĉ_t 虽是因果输入，但由共同训练的 FAE 生成，门控、预测误差和动作质量内生耦合；预先在同一数据域筛选 AUC≥0.65 还会产生选择偏差。应冻结独立训练的 ĉ_t，在未见任务上检验，并与仅过去触觉变化、仅 FAE 不确定度及等触发率随机门控比较。第三，35ms阻塞会改变真实控制周期，但按“控制步”注入延迟的仿真没有建模墙钟时间、云抖动和阻塞期间的接触演化；所谓节省阻塞时间也可能只是降低控制暂停损害。决定性测试是实时调度仿真及真机记录时间戳，加入等时长 no-op 阻塞和计算匹配的非前瞻头。最后，TOST界限若无传感噪声和任务容差依据只是人为门槛；既有动作序列的4/8/16步回放只验证行为策略附近，不能保证新策略诱导状态上的闭环有效性。若因子实验、实时计算匹配对照或策略诱导状态校准失败，贡献应降格为“边缘语义蒸馏加条件计算”，而非触觉 grounding。
evidence: ĥ_e 同时获得当前RGB和语言，足以独立修复视觉语义陈旧；没有“无FAE代理”对照就不能归因于触觉前瞻。
共同训练的FAE既生成门控特征又生成被评估动作，C>随机门控仍可能反映预测置信度或状态难度，而非LCCI×延迟机制。
以控制步模拟网络延迟忽略≤35ms阻塞造成的墙钟延迟和接触继续演化，可能反转真实系统中的收益。
固定真机动作回放未覆盖新策略访问的状态分布；边际TOST与短期发散界不能验证策略诱导的闭环接触转移。

debate.consensus: After three rounds the debate converged on a substantially narrowed but still defensible program, and the moderator approves it with the revisions below folded into finalIdea. Four concessions are settled and non-negotiable. (1) The original LCCI definition leaked future contact information into an online gate; the gate must consume only a causal estimate built from observations strictly before t, with the oracle future-block LCCI retained solely as a reported performance ceiling. (2) The Round-2 cloud-gating algebra was a no-op and was correctly replaced by an edge proxy head that regresses the fresh cloud feature; once that head receives language and current RGB it is an edge semantic distiller, which the advocate conceded, so the headline claim can no longer be attributed to tactile foresight without a factorial that separates proxy substitution from foresight refinement. This is the single most important change: the primary endpoint is re-specified as the incremental effect of gated blocking tactile-foresight refinement over a proxy-distillation-only edge baseline, not over the weak stale-h baseline, with a pre-registered margin of ≥5pp macro-average and a directional requirement that the increment grow with delay and with causal contact-change intensity. (3) Discrete refinement triggering is not learnable by threshold; it becomes straight-through Gumbel-sigmoid with the trigger rate pinned by a Lagrangian to pre-set budgets, which converts gate collapse from a confound into a measurable quantity and makes the rate-matched random-gate control the decisive test of whether gate timing carries information. (4) Control-step delay injection is insufficient because blocking refinement consumes wall-clock time during which contact evolves; the simulator must run a real-time scheduler with wall-clock accounting, and the comparison set must include an equal-duration no-op blocking arm and a compute-matched non-foresight head, otherwise any measured benefit is confounded with, or any measured cost mistaken for, control-pause damage. Simulation credibility is handled by equivalence testing rather than failure to reject, with TOST bounds justified from sensor noise and task tolerance instead of arbitrary numbers, plus policy-induced-state calibration using rollouts of the trained policy rather than replay of behavior-policy actions; if calibration fails, the sim endpoint is demoted to mechanism diagnostics and the hypothesis is reported as undecided within budget rather than backed by weaker evidence. Falsifiability is the program's strongest feature: the conjunctive verdict rule, the explicit go/no-go on instruction-swap sensitivity of the proxy head, and the pre-committed fallback claim ('blocking tactile refinement and conditional computation help; no semantic-grounding claim') mean every plausible outcome maps to a publishable and honest conclusion. Feasibility survives because every added identification control is an inference-time intervention requiring no retraining, but evaluation compute was previously unbudgeted and is now explicitly allocated, the real-robot arm is honestly demoted to 2 tasks × 60 rollouts for directional confirmation only, and training is trimmed to ≤20k edge updates to fund closed-loop evaluation. Impact and novelty are downgraded from 4 to 3: the mechanism story is now one clean question inside a well-controlled harness rather than a new architecture, and much of the lasting value is the released causal-contact-intensity splits, the real-time delay-and-blocking harness, and the identification protocol. That is a legitimate contribution at this budget, so the decision is approve with the revised, scope-limited finalIdea.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether the causal contact-intensity estimator, frozen and trained on a disjoint task subset, retains enough predictive signal (Spearman ρ≥0.3, high-tercile AUC≥0.65) on unseen tasks to make gate timing informative, or whether it degrades to a state-difficulty proxy indistinguishable from a rate-matched random gate.

Whether any residual advantage of the language-conditioned edge proxy head over the stale cloud feature reflects genuine grounding of delayed semantics or simply current-frame visual re-encoding, given that the two cannot be fully separated without an instruction-rich dataset that XHT does not provide.

Whether wall-clock-faithful blocking refinement remains net-positive once contact continues to evolve during the pause; the equal-duration no-op arm may show that measured gains are partly an artifact of pause-free baselines.

Whether policy-induced-state simulation calibration can pass pre-registered equivalence bounds at all for deformable and slip-dominated contacts (sponge, cob), leaving the primary endpoint formally undecided within this budget.

Whether a 120-rollout real-robot arm with roughly 10pp minimum detectable effect can meaningfully corroborate a 5pp incremental sim effect, or whether external validity remains essentially unestablished.
Whether conclusions drawn on four XHT tasks with 800 demonstrations generalize beyond this hand-arm platform and action-chunk controller class.

finalIdea.title: TouchGround-Edge: Isolating Gated Tactile Foresight from Edge Semantic Distillation in Delayed Cloud-Edge VLA Control for Contact-Rich Manipulation
finalIdea.hypothesis: Under wall-clock-faithful delay injection at d_max=10 control steps, adding rate-budgeted blocking tactile-foresight refinement (Foresight Action Expert refined at offsets 4/8/12, gated by a frozen causal contact-intensity estimator) on top of an edge baseline that already includes a language-conditioned proxy head reconstructing the fresh cloud feature raises macro-averaged success on four contact-rich XHT tasks by ≥5 percentage points, with paired bootstrap 95% confidence intervals excluding zero on ≥400 closed-loop simulation rollouts per condition; the increment grows with delay and with causal contact-change intensity (significant delay×intensity interaction in a mixed-effects model), exceeds a trigger-rate-matched random gate, exceeds an equal-duration no-op blocking arm and a compute-matched non-foresight refinement head, and accounts for ≥70% of its gain through reduction of contact-class failures. If the increment is absent or does not exceed the rate-matched and compute-matched controls, the semantic-grounding narrative is withdrawn and the reported conclusion is that edge semantic distillation, not tactile foresight, compensates cloud staleness.
finalIdea.motivation: CloudEdgeVLA shows stale cloud semantics plus fresh local vision can preserve manipulation under network delay, but its evaluation is dominated by pick-and-place where contact dynamics are secondary. ReTouch shows contact state evolves faster than a fixed action block and that blocking refinement of tactile predictions improves dexterous success. The open question is whether tactile foresight is a genuinely distinct fast loop or merely a stand-in for refreshing stale visual semantics at the edge. Three rounds of adversarial review established that this question cannot be answered by comparing a full system against a stale-feature baseline: an edge head that sees current RGB and the language instruction can repair semantic staleness on its own, an online gate defined over future contact change leaks its own label, a learned discrete trigger threshold has no gradient, and delay measured in control steps hides the wall-clock cost of blocking. This proposal therefore reframes the study as a factorial isolation of the tactile-foresight contribution inside a real-time-faithful delay harness, with the gate treated as a testable timing mechanism rather than an assumed benefit.
method: Retain the async split: a frozen cloud OpenVLA-OFT LoRA encodes delayed (o_{t-d}, language) into h; the edge runs frozen SigLIP on current RGB and a frozen tactile-patch encoder over a 10-frame tactile history; the edge never blocks on the cloud and always consumes the most recently received h.

Edge cloud-proxy head P (≤5M parameters, <2ms): a 2-layer MLP mapping current z_t, the cached per-episode language embedding, and (in the foresight-enabled arms) the FAE tactile latent to an estimate of the fresh cloud feature, supervised by cosine plus L1 against Phase-A-cached h_fresh. Fusion uses h′=(1−g)·h+g·ĥ_e. Because P is language-conditioned it is explicitly reported as lightweight cloud-feature distillation, with parameters and latency itemized separately, not as a zero-cost mechanism.

Foresight Action Expert (FAE) on the edge predicts a 16-step future tactile latent and action suffix from current edge observations; when triggered, it recursively refines the future tactile latent with the newest tactile feedback and regenerates the remaining action suffix (ReTouch-style blocking refinement) under a ≤35ms wall-clock cap, with fallback to the existing one-shot suffix if the cap is exceeded.

Causal contact-intensity estimator ĉ_t: computed only from tactile-embedding change rates over frames strictly before t plus past force magnitude and an online stage posterior estimated from past observations; residualized against deployment-available covariates only (no ground-truth stage, no future force). ĉ_t is trained separately on a disjoint task subset, frozen before Phase B, and validated on unseen tasks against the oracle future-block intensity (go/no-go: Spearman ρ≥0.3 and high-tercile AUC≥0.65). The oracle-gated variant C_oracle is run only as a reported observability ceiling.

Staleness-Contact Gating (SCG): continuous gate g=σ(w·[ĉ_t, s, ĉ_t·s]+b) with s=d/d_max, trained end-to-end and used for both fusion blending and the tactile blend T′=(1−g)·T_curr+g·T_fae. Discrete refinement triggering uses straight-through Gumbel-sigmoid; the threshold is not learned but set by budget quantile, with the trigger rate constrained by a Lagrangian term to targets ρ∈{10%,25%,40%} swept as a hyperparameter, and the former hard sparsity penalty replaced by the relaxed E[σ(·)] form to remove zero gradients.
Fuse h′, z_t, and T′ through a Vision-Augmented Action Head producing 16-step continuous actions via flow matching (10-step Euler inference).

Real-time scheduling simulator: wall-clock accounting for cloud round-trip with jitter, edge inference cost, and blocking-refinement pauses, during which the contact simulation continues to advance. Component latencies are calibrated against timestamps recorded on the physical XHand–UR7e stack. Control-step-only delay injection is retained solely as a legacy sanity check, never as a primary endpoint.

Training budget (≤8×H100×7d, with evaluation compute explicitly budgeted): Phase A (≤1d) precompute h_fresh and h_stale for all XHT windows at d~Uniform(1,d_max) and pre-train/freeze ĉ_t on the disjoint subset; Phase B (≤3.5d) train FAE, proxy head P, SCG parameters, fusion head, and tactile-to-action adapters for ≤20k updates (global batch 8, bf16, AdamW 2.5e-5→2.5e-6, 1k warmup, clip 1.0) with dual-path loss L=(1−λ)||â_fresh−a_t||₁+λ||â_stale−a_t||₁ on cached h, proxy-reconstruction loss, FAE–HAE cosine alignment (0.1), and the relaxed trigger-rate term; Phase C (≤1.5d) closed-loop evaluation and identification controls; ≤1d buffer. No live 7B forwards during Phase B.

Pre-registered factorial ablation (primary): 2×2 over proxy head P {off, on} × FAE gated refinement {off, on}, i.e. A = stale h only, B = P only, C = FAE only, D = P + gated FAE. The primary endpoint is the FAE main effect and its interaction with delay and causal contact intensity, evaluated against B as the reference baseline rather than against A. A z_t+language-only proxy variant (no FAE latent input) is included to prevent the proxy head from absorbing foresight credit.

Pre-registered identification controls, all inference-time interventions requiring no retraining: trigger-rate-matched random gate R at each ρ; equal-duration no-op blocking arm; compute-matched non-foresight refinement head; shuffled-h and shuffled-ĉ_t; temporally misaligned tactile input; and exogenous clamping of g to fixed quantiles {0.1,0.5,0.9} crossed 2×2 with h/shuffled-h under matched initial states and paired seeds, so that cloud-dependence claims rest on randomized rather than model-selected gate values.

Simulation credibility gate (three-part, pre-registered): TOST equivalence on normal force and slip-onset timing with bounds derived from measured sensor noise and task tolerance (not arbitrary thresholds); multi-step divergence bounds at 4/8/16 steps evaluated on states induced by the trained policy itself, not only on replay of recorded behavior-policy actions; and condition-B sim-versus-real success difference ≤10pp. Sample size is set by power analysis on existing XHT real trajectories, expanding from 100 to 200 if needed, with no new teleoperation. If any part fails, the closed-loop sim endpoint is demoted to mechanism diagnostics and the hypothesis is reported as undecided within this budget.

Secondary real-robot confirmation, honestly de-powered: 2 tasks × 60 rollouts × conditions B and D at d_max=10 (120 rollouts) on XHand–UR7e with recorded timestamps, reported as directional confirmation with its ~10pp minimum detectable effect stated; the remaining two tasks receive a small pre-registered direction-consistency check only.

Release the causal contact-intensity splits, the real-time delay-and-blocking harness, gate parameters, and all identification-control scripts; the default tactile encoder is π₀+tactile fine-tuned 5k steps on XHT patches, with a ReTouch-initialized arm as a sensitivity check only.
evaluation: Primary (closed-loop simulation, wall-clock faithful): four contact-rich XHT tasks (Pipette Press, Bottle Grasp, Cob Grasp, Sponge Wipe), ≥400 paired rollouts per condition at d_max=10 with fixed initial states, paired seeds, and frozen policies; report the 2×2 factorial with macro-average success, paired bootstrap 95% CIs, and a pre-specified ≥5pp superiority margin for the FAE increment over the proxy-only baseline B. The margin is a superiority test with a minimum effect size, not a non-inferiority test.

Mechanism identification: FAE increment stratified by causal contact intensity and by delay, with a mixed-effects delay×intensity interaction test; D versus rate-matched R at each ρ∈{10%,25%,40%}; D versus equal-duration no-op blocking and versus the compute-matched non-foresight head; contact-class failure decomposition requiring ≥70% of the gain to come from contact failures.

Gate validity and cost of observability: ĉ_t predictive validity on unseen tasks (Spearman ρ, high-tercile AUC), gap between D and D_oracle, realized trigger rate versus target, mean and tail blocking time, and collapse detection against the always-refine arm.

Cloud-dependence test under randomization: exogenously clamped g ∈ {0.1,0.5,0.9} crossed with h versus shuffled-h at matched states; a real reduction in the low-g cells with no reduction in the high-g cells is required to claim that gating modulates reliance on cloud semantics.

Proxy-head go/no-go: same-scene instruction swap at identical initial states; if ĥ_e output cosine changes by <0.05 or high-g success degrades to instruction-independent levels, the proxy head is judged to have failed and the cloud-semantic-grounding claim is withdrawn entirely, retaining only tactile conditional-computation conclusions.

Simulation calibration report: TOST outcomes with noise-and-tolerance-justified bounds, policy-induced-state divergence at 4/8/16 steps, and the condition-B sim-to-real success gap, published before primary unblinding.

Latency sweep and OOD (sim only): delay AUC for D versus B at d_max∈{0,5,10,20} (200 rollouts) and ReTouch challenge variants (sponge height change, cob position offset) at d_max=10 with ≥20 rollouts per variant.

Contact-specific diagnostics on 100 held-out trajectories (open-loop, diagnostic only): future tactile latent cosine similarity and action-suffix MSE at offsets 4/8/12 comparing one-shot, gated, and always-refine refinement.

Real-robot secondary: 120 rollouts (2 tasks × 60, conditions B and D) with recorded wall-clock timestamps; report sim-to-real gap and directional agreement, with the underpowering stated explicitly rather than treated as confirmation.
finalIdea.expectedContribution: A factorial isolation of blocking tactile foresight from edge semantic distillation under network delay, evaluated in a wall-clock-faithful cloud-edge harness with pre-registered identification controls. Concretely: (i) a causal, deployment-available contact-intensity estimator with released splits and an oracle-gap measurement of its observability cost; (ii) a rate-budgeted straight-through gating mechanism whose timing information content is testable against a rate-matched random gate; (iii) a real-time delay-and-blocking simulator with equivalence-tested and policy-induced-state calibration, including equal-duration no-op and compute-matched controls that most prior blocking-refinement results lack; and (iv) a pre-committed decision rule that maps every outcome to an honest claim, from 'gated tactile foresight grounds delayed cloud semantics' down to 'edge semantic distillation plus conditional computation explains the gains'.
finalIdea.impactAssessment: Moderate. The engineering question—when a delayed cloud VLA needs a local tactile fast loop, and whether paying a blocking pause is worth it—is directly relevant to mobile manipulators that offload large models, and the rate-budgeted trigger gives a deployable knob. The harness and controls are reusable beyond this system and correct a recurring measurement flaw, since benefits of blocking refinement are routinely reported without accounting for wall-clock pauses or matched compute. Impact is bounded by the single platform, dense-tactile requirement, four tasks, and 800 demonstrations, and by the real possibility that the honest answer is negative or undecided. A clean negative result that attributes gains to edge distillation rather than tactile foresight is still useful, because it redirects effort from tactile prediction toward cheap semantic caching at the edge.
finalIdea.noveltyAssessment: Moderate. The architecture is composed from existing parts: CloudEdgeVLA-style dual-path stale-feature training, ReTouch-style blocking tactile refinement, standard conditional-computation gating, and a small distillation head. The advocate conceded that the language-conditioned proxy head is cloud-feature distillation, so no novel module is claimed. Remaining novelty lies in the causal latency×contact coupling diagnostic, the rate-budgeted gating formulation whose collapse is measurable rather than assumed away, the real-time blocking-aware evaluation harness with equal-duration no-op and compute-matched controls, and the factorial protocol that separates foresight from semantic refresh. This is methodological and empirical novelty rather than architectural novelty, and it is stated as such.
finalIdea.resourceAssessment: Feasible but tight, and only after explicitly budgeting evaluation. 8×H100 for 7 days (~1,344 GPU-hours), allocated as: Phase A ≤1d (offline h_fresh/h_stale cache plus independent training and freezing of ĉ_t on a disjoint task subset), Phase B ≤3.5d (≤20k edge updates, reduced from 25k to fund evaluation), Phase C ≤1.5d closed-loop simulation with batched parallel environments and periodic frozen 7B cloud forwards on one GPU, ≤1d buffer. Every identification control is an inference-time intervention needing no retraining, which is what keeps the expanded protocol affordable; the binding constraint is closed-loop rollout throughput, roughly 4,000 total rollouts across the factorial, controls, sweep, and OOD variants. No new teleoperation: XHT-Dataset (800 train / 100 held-out) is reused, one task reserved for validation monitoring, one disjoint subset reserved for the gate estimator. Real-robot cost drops to 120 rollouts plus reuse of existing trajectories for calibration. Deployment inference matches the disclosed split: cloud 7B on one GPU, edge SigLIP + FAE + proxy head + gate on RTX-class hardware under a ≤35ms refinement cap.
finalIdea.trainingResources: 8× NVIDIA H100, 7 calendar days, bf16 mixed precision. Phase A ≤1d for the h cache and independent contact-intensity estimator; Phase B ≤3.5d for ≤20k edge policy updates covering FAE, the ≤5M-parameter language-conditioned proxy head, SCG parameters, fusion head, and tactile adapters, at global batch size 8 with AdamW, gradient clip 1.0, 1,000-step warmup, cosine decay 2.5e-5→2.5e-6, straight-through Gumbel-sigmoid triggering with a Lagrangian rate constraint at ρ∈{10%,25%,40%}, and relaxed E[σ(·)] regularization; Phase C ≤1.5d reserved for closed-loop evaluation and identification controls; ≤1d buffer. Initialization from OpenVLA-OFT LoRA and π₀+tactile (5k XHT steps), with an optional ReTouch sensitivity arm. No live 7B forwards during Phase B, no 7B pretraining, no new data collection.
risks: The FAE increment over the proxy-only baseline B may be small or zero, meaning current-frame semantic refresh at the edge explains the original gains; the factorial is designed to expose this, and the pre-committed fallback is to report edge semantic distillation plus conditional computation as the finding.

Wall-clock-faithful blocking may erase the benefit: contact continues to evolve during the ≤35ms pause, and the equal-duration no-op arm may reveal that measured gains partly reflect pause-free baselines rather than better predictions.

The frozen causal contact-intensity estimator may fail its unseen-task validity gate, or may act only as a state-difficulty proxy, in which case gated refinement will not beat the rate-matched random gate and no timing mechanism can be claimed.

Simulation calibration may fail equivalence testing or policy-induced-state divergence bounds, especially for deformable and slip-dominated contacts, leaving the primary endpoint undecided within budget; the protocol commits to reporting 'undecided' rather than substituting weaker evidence.
The 120-rollout real-robot arm has roughly 10pp minimum detectable effect and cannot independently confirm a 5pp incremental effect, so external validity remains weakly established.

Closed-loop rollout throughput, not gradient updates, is the binding compute constraint; if simulation is slower than projected, the identification controls must be trimmed by a pre-registered priority order (rate-matched gate, no-op blocking, and compute-matched head are protected first).
The conjunctive verdict rule makes a fully positive result unlikely, and results may remain confined to four tasks on one hand-arm platform with dense tactile sensing, limiting generalization claims.
Contribution value depends on releasing the harness, splits, and control scripts; incomplete artifact release would leave little durable value if the mechanism result is negative.

idea.title: Device-Confirmed Module Attribution as a Corpus Signal for Mobile-Native LLM Architecture Generation
idea.hypothesis: If a pre-registered Phase-0 pilot passes all four gates (compile-time ablatable yield >=60% and deploy-export success >=90% on 50 LLM-generated LEMUR graphs; measured discordant-pair count b+c on 20 real module ablations implying a paired on-device McNemar MDE <=0.8pp at n=3000; host-vs-device INT8 agreement >=99% restricted to ablation-flipped samples, not aggregate; and thermal drift of an interleaved reference binary <=2% of its median NNAPI latency), then across five paired generation seeds a closed loop whose QLoRA corpus is labeled with device-confirmed, sham-surviving module attributions (arm A) will achieve a larger cycle-3-minus-cycle-0 gain in sequestered s_mobile than a dose-matched loop gated on s_mobile alone (arm B), under an exact paired permutation test over seeds at one-sided alpha=0.05; and the confirmed module effects will exceed all three equal-budget sham families. If either the trajectory-level test or the sham margins fail, the pre-registered conclusion is that host-side screening plus device latency gating is a useful deployment-screening heuristic and that module-level counterfactual attribution provides no additional signal.
idea.motivation: The mobile-deployment closed loop gains on CIFAR-10 but never beats an unadapted CIFAR-100 baseline while GPU accuracy keeps rising, suggesting the generator is rewarded for a proxy that does not survive INT8 deployment. Counterfactual-audit work shows aggregate metrics can hide content-specific shifts detectable only through dense, calibrated interventions, and SeDeM motivates decoupling compact generation from target-conditioned selection. Three rounds of adversarial review reshaped this intuition into something testable. Round 1 showed a full dense ablation grid exceeds tablet wall clock and that 256-image holdouts cannot stabilize per-module bootstrap CIs. Round 2 exposed metric conflation between the deployability gate and the attribution score, an undercounted device budget, and unbuilt ablation infrastructure. Round 3 established the two decisive constraints that shape this version: the 'GPU up / mobile down' pattern does not uniquely identify proxy misalignment (PTQ calibration drift, exporter regressions, thermal throttling, and search variance all produce it), so mechanism claims must be carried by shams rather than by that observation; and image-level paired inference on a single trajectory cannot substitute for trajectory-level inference, so the design must fund five complete seeds with real NNAPI measurement rather than three seeds plus a latency proxy. The remaining question is deliberately modest and answerable within budget: does labeling a deployment-aware finetuning corpus with device-confirmed module attributions buy anything over gating on the deployability score alone?
method: Phase 0 (days 1-2, pre-registered go/no-go, ~40 device binaries): extend TuneNNGen --mobile_deployment to emit four ablatable macro-types (conv block, depthwise separable, skip, head) with a compile-time validator; freeze filler semantics (conv: 1x1 identity, scale=1; depthwise: pointwise group=1 passthrough; skip: zero residual branch; head: uniform logit bias); on 50 generated graphs require ablatable yield >=60% and export success >=90%; on 20 real ablations of the cycle-0 CIFAR-100 baseline measure the discordant-pair count b+c on-device and require the implied McNemar MDE <=0.8pp at n=3000, host-vs-device agreement >=99% computed only over ablation-flipped samples, and reference-binary thermal drift <=2%. Publish the worst-case device binary manifest, the deterministic truncation rule, and the spill order before any main-campaign run; any gate failure stops the campaign and is reported as a negative infrastructure result.

Data partition, fixed before cycle 0: CIFAR-100 test split into 2000 Phase-0 calibration images, 3000 selection images (openly adaptive; used for gating, host screening, and QLoRA curation, with no confirmatory claims), 3000 sequestered images (device-measured, unsealed exactly once after cycle 3 for the primary endpoint), and 2000 untouched reserve.

Paired A/B loop: 5 generation seeds (42-46) x 2 arms x cycles 0-3, K=6 candidates per cycle. Arms share the cycle-0 population, generation seeds, candidate counts, device budget, and QLoRA hyperparameters and corpus size; they differ only in corpus labeling (arm A: device-confirmed attribution traces plus demotion traces for modules with positive GPU delta-acc and negative on-device delta-a_int8; arm B: s_mobile-ranked traces only, token-count and trace-count matched).

Deployability metric: s_mobile = a_int8 / (t_best / t_ref_c0), dimensionless against the frozen cycle-0 reference latency. t_best is the median of 20 runs on a single pre-registered backend (NNAPI); CPU and GPU delegates are recorded as diagnostics only and never enter a gate, eliminating min-over-backends selection bias. Exporter version hash, calibration set, cooldown interval, and an interleaved reference binary are frozen for the whole campaign.

Screening stage (zero device cost): for the top-3 GPU/INT8-divergent candidates per cycle, ablate up to 3 modules each on the host INT8 interpreter over the 3000-image selection set at one-sided alpha=0.10; rank survivors by screen statistic and pass a fixed, pre-registered number (6 module interventions per seed per cycle, at cycles 1 and 2 only) to device confirmation regardless of effect magnitude, so the truncation is deterministic rather than outcome-adaptive.

Confirmation stage (device): each passed intervention is exported as an ablated binary plus its type-matched primary filler binary and measured on-device; the confirmatory statistic is the paired McNemar test on delta-a_int8 versus filler. The two remaining filler variants and the ablation-recalibrated PTQ variant are reported as descriptive sign-consistency, never pooled via random-effects or I-squared, since the six conditions share weights, calibration set, and images.

Sham controls with matched budget and matched corpus dose: (i) random module labels, (ii) iso-parameter structural substitution, (iii) PTQ-only recalibration with no structural change. One sham intervention per family per seed per cycle is confirmed on-device. A module is called attributed only if its confirmed effect exceeds the maximum of the three sham distributions at the pre-registered margin; otherwise it is labeled quantization/compile sensitivity and may enter the corpus but never a gate.

Cycle gate: accept augmentation only if the best candidate reaches s_mobile >= 0.99 x s_ref on the selection set; rank on s_mobile, break ties with the count of sham-surviving attributed modules. GPU accuracy never gates.
QLoRA-finetune ABrain/NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag for 3 epochs per arm per cycle on the previous cycle's corpus, with arm-specific labeling as defined above.

Primary analysis: unseal the sequestered set once; compute per-seed (A_cycle3 - A_cycle0) - (B_cycle3 - B_cycle0) in device-measured s_mobile and test with an exact paired permutation over the 5 seeds (one-sided alpha=0.05, which requires 5/5 sign agreement). Module and sham family comparisons use Holm correction within their families and are secondary. The pre-registered downgrade rule applies verbatim if the primary test fails.

Falsifiers: primary, the permutation test on the A-B difference-in-differences is non-significant; secondary, confirmed module effects do not exceed sham maxima; tertiary, Phase-0 gate failure. Diagnostics reported regardless: Spearman(GPU epoch-1 accuracy, s_mobile) per cycle (descriptive, explicitly non-identifying), ablation-valid fraction, deploy success with 95% CI, and the reconciled device manifest.
evaluation: Primary endpoint: trajectory-level paired difference-in-differences of device-measured sequestered s_mobile between the attribution-labeled arm and the s_mobile-only arm across 5 seeds, exact permutation test, one-sided alpha=0.05.

Attribution validity: fraction of device-confirmed modules whose paired McNemar delta-a_int8 versus type-matched filler is significant after Holm correction, and the margin by which their effect distribution exceeds each of the three sham families.

Robustness (descriptive, not inferential): sign agreement of each confirmed module effect across the two secondary fillers and the ablation-recalibrated PTQ condition, reported as raw counts with per-condition CIs and no pooling.

Measurement validity: host-vs-device INT8 agreement restricted to ablation-flipped samples, reference-binary thermal drift over the campaign, and export-failure counts by macro-type (to detect non-random depletion of an intervention family).

Divergence diagnostic: per-cycle Spearman(GPU epoch-1 accuracy, s_mobile), reported as motivation-level context only, with the explicit statement that it does not identify proxy misalignment against PTQ drift, exporter regression, or thermal alternatives.

Efficiency and budget reconciliation: realized device binaries against the pre-registered worst-case manifest (210 baseline latency + 180 attribution/sham confirmation + 15 sequestered accuracy + 40 Phase-0 = 445 of a 480 cap), plus the invoked spill order if any.

Ablations: (i) screening stage without device confirmation, (ii) device gating without any attribution labeling (this is arm B), (iii) 1500- vs 3000-image sequestered set for effect stability, (iv) GPU-threshold prefilter retained vs removed.
idea.expectedContribution: A pre-registered, budget-closed test of whether module-level counterfactual attribution adds anything beyond deployability gating in LLM-driven mobile NAS, delivered with the measurement scaffolding the debate showed to be missing: compile-time ablation validation with frozen type-matched fillers, a strict separation between zero-cost host screening and device-confirmed inference, three equal-budget sham families that carry the mechanism claim, trajectory-level rather than image-level inference over five complete seeds, and a binding downgrade rule that reports the result as a deployment-screening heuristic when the causal reading is unsupported. Every terminal state (Phase-0 infrastructure failure, null corpus effect, sham-indistinguishable modules, or a positive attribution effect) is informative and pre-committed.
idea.impactAssessment: A positive result would give deployment-aware LLM finetuning a concrete, auditable corpus signal and would show that hard mobile tasks stall on proxy misalignment rather than insufficient search. A null result is nearly as useful and is the more likely outcome: it would bound the value of module-level counterfactual probing under INT8 quantization noise and redirect effort toward quantization-aware generation or better deployability proxies. The Phase-0 gates alone produce a reusable, publishable measurement result about whether sub-1pp macro-module effects are resolvable at all on commodity mobile hardware. Impact is real but bounded by single-device, single-backend, single-dataset scope.
idea.noveltyAssessment: The novelty is no longer the causal-attribution claim, which was retracted during review, but the combination of a paired dose-matched A/B over generation trajectories, host-screen/device-confirm separation for quantized counterfactuals, and three equal-budget sham families applied to CNN macro-modules inside a closed LLM architecture-generation loop. No prior work tests whether attribution labeling of a NAS finetuning corpus has incremental value against a matched control arm; existing counterfactual-audit work targets KV blocks and long-context memory rather than exported INT8 mobile graphs. This is a solid methodological contribution rather than a conceptual breakthrough.
idea.resourceAssessment: GPU: Phase-0 validator sweep and bootstrap pilot ~20 H100-hours; 210 one-epoch CIFAR-100 candidate trainings (30 at cycle 0 plus 5 seeds x 2 arms x 3 cycles x 6 candidates) ~20-50 H100-hours; 30 QLoRA runs (5 seeds x 2 arms x 3 cycles, 3 epochs each) ~60-90 H100-hours. Total ~150 H100-hours against 1344 available under 8xH100 for 7 days, leaving room for reruns; candidate trainings and QLoRA runs parallelize across the 8 GPUs. Device: one SM-P613, worst-case 445 binaries at ~2.5 minutes each including load and cooldown (~19 hours) plus 15 sequestered accuracy passes over 3000 images (~2 hours), scriptable overnight across days 3-6 with 35 binaries of slack and a pre-registered spill order (drop the iso-parameter sham at cycle 2 first, then cycle-2 attribution confirmations) if export retries consume it. Schedule: days 1-2 Phase 0, days 3-6 cycles, day 7 unsealing and analysis. The campaign is device-wall-clock-bound, not GPU-bound, which is why all screening accuracy was moved to the host.
idea.trainingResources: Phase 0: 1 H100 for the TuneNNGen/LEMUR extension, 50-graph validator sweep, and 20-module device pilot. Main campaign: up to 4 H100s for parallel 1-epoch CIFAR-100 candidate training, 2 H100s for QLoRA (3 epochs x 30 arm-cycles), one Android SM-P613 for all confirmatory latency and sequestered accuracy (<=445 binaries against a 480 cap, reconciled against the pre-registered manifest), and a Linux workstation for PTQ, TFLite export, host INT8 screening, and compile-time ablation validation. No LLM pretraining.
risks: Phase-0 may fail any of its four gates, most plausibly the conditional host-device agreement or the 0.8pp MDE, stopping the campaign before cycle 1 and leaving only a negative infrastructure result.
At five seeds the exact permutation test needs unanimous sign agreement, so a genuine but moderate corpus effect will land in an uninterpretable middle zone rather than being detected.
Compressing to three improvement cycles (from six) to fund five seeds may not leave enough loop iterations for a corpus-labeling difference to change generated architectures at all.
True macro-module INT8 effects may sit below 0.5pp, in which case the attribution layer is under-powered by construction regardless of measurement quality.

Frozen filler semantics may not be uniquely realizable on some generated LEMUR graphs, and export failures clustering on one macro-type would non-randomly deplete an intervention family despite the deterministic truncation rule.
Dose-matching the two QLoRA corpora equalizes size and format but not label entropy or motif coverage, leaving a residual confound if arm A wins.
All confirmatory measurement comes from one tablet, one NNAPI backend, and one exporter hash; thermal and compiler idiosyncrasies are controlled within the campaign but not shown to generalize.
Device wall clock has only 35 binaries of slack; a hardware fault or a systematic export regression would trigger the spill order and reduce sham coverage at cycle 2.

refinements.originalIdeaTitle: Counterfactual Module Attribution for Mobile-Native LLM Architecture Generation
critiquesAddressed: Full dense ablation grid (~1,920 extra TFLite exports plus device runs) dominates wall clock on one SM-P613 and is not credibly completable alongside baseline parity within a 7-day campaign, even if GPU-hours fit.
256-image holdout cannot support stable per-module bootstrap CIs for Δa_int8; INT8 PTQ noise will swamp c_m and undermine the proposed causal-validity metric.
Unvalidated LEMUR ablation compatibility will shrink valid candidates below the ≥2 acceptance threshold and confound the primary CIFAR-100 falsifier.
Benign filler controls are unspecified for depthwise, skip, and head macro-types, weakening causal claims the gate depends on.
Running identical 6-cycle × K=20 protocols on both CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 doubles mobile cost without sharpening the stated CIFAR-100 stall hypothesis.
refinements.revisedHypothesis: A two-stage counterfactual gate—(i) cheap GPU–INT8 divergence prefilter on all K candidates, then (ii) dense-calibrated ablation on only the top-5 divergent models per cycle over four validated macro-module types—will raise CIFAR-100 holdout s_causal above the cycle-0 MobileDeploymentFinetuner reference by cycle 3, because modules selected by isolated INT8 Δa_int8/Δt_best under matched benign controls causally drive deployability rather than spurious GPU epoch-1 accuracy.
revisedMethod: Extend TuneNNGen --mobile_deployment to emit LEMUR-compatible graphs with four ablatable macro-types (conv block, depthwise separable, skip, head) and a compile-time ablation validator that rejects non-ablatable candidates before training.

Per cycle on CIFAR-100 (primary) with CIFAR-10 limited to cycles 0 and 3 as sanity checks: generate K=12 candidates; train 1 GPU epoch each; PTQ to INT8 TFLite; measure baseline a_int8 and t_best on a fixed 512-image stratified holdout using the frozen SM-P613 protocol.
Compute divergence d = rank(GPU acc) − rank(s_baseline); retain top-5 candidates with d above the cycle median for counterfactual probing only.

For each retained candidate and each ablatable module m: export ablated INT8 model with m zeroed/skipped plus a type-matched benign filler control; remeasure a_int8 and t_best; define c_m = (Δa_int8)_m / max(ε, (Δt_best)_m) with ε=1 ms; aggregate s_causal = sum of top-3 positive c_m.
Accept cycle augmentation only if best s_causal ≥ 0.99·s_ref and ≥2 valid ablatable models; rank and gate exclusively on s_causal, not GPU accuracy.

QLoRA-finetune ABrain/NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag for 3 epochs on D_{c-1} augmented with chat traces labeling high-c_m patterns and explicitly demoting modules with positive GPU Δacc but negative Δa_int8 under ablation.
Run 6 cycles (seed 42) on CIFAR-100 and 2 checkpoint cycles on CIFAR-10; ablate only on CIFAR-100. Budget mobile runs to ≤480 device evaluations via the top-5 filter (vs ~2,400 in full grid).

Primary falsifier unchanged: CIFAR-100 peak s_causal ≤ baseline cycle-0 s_ref after cycle 3; secondary diagnostics include Spearman(GPU acc, s_causal), ablation success rate, and deploy success 95% CI.
refinements.rationale: The core idea is timely and falsifiable—proxy misalignment between GPU training signals and INT8 deployability plausibly explains the CIFAR-100 stall—but the submitted plan overshoots single-device wall clock, underpowers per-module inference, and leaves ablation/control semantics underspecified. GPU compute alone fits 8×H100×7 days (~1344 GPU-hours vs ~70–100 estimated), yet the experiment is mobile-run-bound; the revised two-stage gate and CIFAR-100-first scope restore feasibility without abandoning the causal claim. Feasibility remains below the acceptance bar until the ablation validator yield and 512-image paired-bootstrap stability are piloted in round 2.

turns.claim:
我支持该提案的可检验骨架，并以四项可操作修订加固它，同时承认三处真实弱点。

应予保留：(1) Phase-0 预注册 go/no-go 把「基础设施不可行」转成可发表的负结果，而非沉没成本；(2) s_mobile（部署门控）与 s_attrib（模块排序）显式分离，堵住 round-2 指出的度量混用；(3) 类型匹配良性填充（identity conv / passthrough depthwise / zero-skip / uniform head bias）使 c_m 有对照，而非纯删除伪影。

承认的弱点与修订：
A1 c_m 比值定义不稳。当 |Δt_best|→0 时 ε=1ms 主导分母，延迟噪声被放大成「因果」。改为：ε 由 Phase-0 重测差异分布的 95 分位标定（同一模型 20 次×3 后端、重复两轮），接受判据改为二维词典序——先要求 Δa_int8 配对自举 95% CI 排除 0，再以 Δt_best 排序；c_m 仅用于 QLoRA 语料标注，不进入门控。
A2 512 图对 CIFAR-100 太粗（≈每类 5 图，准确率二项 SE≈2%，远大于单模块效应）。改为解耦两类测量：a_int8 在主机 TFLite INT8 解释器上用 2000 图测，t_best 仍只在 SM-P613 上测；Phase-0 先做位一致性检验（主机 vs 设备在 512 图上 top-1 一致率 ≥99.5%），不通过则退回纯设备测量并接受更宽 CI。同时把消融主量从 Δ准确率换成「与未消融模型的配对 top-1 一致率」与 ΔNLL，配对方差可低一个量级。
A3 「Spearman(GPU acc, s_mobile) 下降」作为次要指标会被选择效应污染：在 top-5 子集上计算必然出现范围限制衰减。改为每周期在全部 K=12 候选上计算，并新增无归因对照臂 B（同 K=12、只按 s_mobile 门控、不做消融、不注入 c_m 轨迹、与 A 臂共享 cycle-0），使「归因」与「移动门控」两种效应可分离——否则 cycle-3 falsifier 无法归因。
A4 预算与单种子。把消融限于第 1/3/5 周期：A 臂 12×6 + 5×6×2×3 = 252，B 臂 72，CIFAR-10 检查点约 24，合计约 350 ≤ 480，正好为 B 臂腾出额度。s_ref 冻结于 cycle-0（不随周期漂移），0.99 容差仅对冻结参考生效，避免逐周期下滑棘轮。种子 42 单轨迹是真实局限：结论只对该轨迹成立，需在 cycle 0/3 各加 3 个生成种子，并对 6 周期趋势做 Page 趋势检验而非只看峰值。

边界声明：若 A2 位一致性检验失败或 A3 对照臂无预算，我接受主张退化为「仅移动门控」的弱版本，不再声称模块级因果。
evidence: 基线现象本身即可分辨前提：CIFAR-10 有增益、CIFAR-100 不超未适配基线、而 GPU 精度仍上升。这一「GPU 升 / 移动降」的反向组合是代理错配的直接signature，而搜索不足只会表现为两者同时停滞；A/B 双臂设计正是把这两种解释分开的最小实验。
方差量级可先验计算：512 图 CIFAR-100 约每类 5 图，p≈0.5 时准确率 SE≈2.2%，单个 macro-module 的 INT8 精度效应通常在 0.3–1%，故原 512 图 Δa_int8 无法稳定；改用配对 top-1 一致率/ΔNLL 后配对方差显著下降，且 Phase-0 的 20 模块自举可直接对比两种度量的 CI 宽度，构成对 A2 的低成本预验证。
选择效应是可量化的：在 top-5 子集上算 Spearman 属于截尾样本，衰减部分来自门控本身而非生成器改变；只有在 K=12 全池上计算并与无归因对照臂 B 相减，才能给出「归因训练降低 GPU–移动相关性」的净效应估计。
预算核对可闭合：A 臂 252 + B 臂 72 + CIFAR-10 检查点约 24 ≈ 350 次设备评估（每次含 20 runs×3 后端），低于 480 硬上限；把消融从 6 周期压到 1/3/5 三个周期换取对照臂，比原方案「低产周期跳过消融」更可预注册，也避免跳过策略与 cycle-3 falsifier 混淆。

turns.claim: 核心因果主张目前不成立。首先，删除模块与“良性填充”都改变张量分布、量化尺度、融合和编译图；identity conv、zero residual、uniform head并非跨图语义中性，因此正Δa_int8最多说明该特定干预有效，不能识别原模块“因果驱动可部署性”。其次，没有同预算、同生成随机性的“仅按s_mobile选择”对照臂；cycle-3提升可能来自反复设备筛选、QLoRA或随机搜索，而非归因信号。第三，c_m以接近零且有噪声的|Δt|作分母，ε=1ms又依赖单位和设备尺度；top-3正值及top-5预筛造成双重赢家偏差，bootstrap若未完整重做选择过程会严重低估不确定性。第四，s_mobile=a_int8/t_best本身随时间单位变化，且从CPU/GPU/NNAPI中取最小中位数会产生多重比较偏差；“相关性下降”也不代表代理错配被修复，可能只是范围截断或噪声增大。决定性测试应是预注册A/B：A使用归因轨迹，B仅用s_mobile，匹配候选、设备预算和生成种子；至少3个独立轨迹，以冻结cycle-0参考比较cycle-3差值的置信区间。同时对每个模块做多种可实现填充并重校准PTQ，只有效应跨填充、跨校准和跨种子同号才允许称为模块归因。Phase-0还应以预设最小效应和绝对CI宽度判定，而非含义不清且可随基线噪声放宽的“≤2×SE”。若A不显著优于B，应将贡献降格为部署筛选启发式，而非反事实因果NAS。
evidence: 预算口径未闭合：5×6×2×6=360个消融配置，加72个候选基线、cycle-0/参考及CIFAR-10后已逼近或超过480；若“评估”按20次×3后端运行计，则远超上限。
512图在准确率约0.5时非配对SE约2.2%；预期模块效应若低于百分点级，20个事后挑选模块不足以证明CI稳定或覆盖率正确。
从候选中按散度选top-5、模块中取top-3正c_m，再报告普通bootstrap CI，未重现完整选择流程，属于选择后推断，显著性会偏乐观。
不同填充会改变激活范围、量化参数及算子融合；若不固定或重新校准PTQ并做多填充一致性检验，Δa_int8无法区分模块语义、量化校准和编译器效应。

turns.claim:
接受怀疑方四点中的三点半，并以五项可预注册修订保留可检验内核，同时主动降级不当声称。

C1（让步并重定义估计量）：不再声称「原模块因果驱动可部署性」。估计量改为显式的干预族平均效应：每模块施加≥3种可实现填充（identity/passthrough、类型匹配均值张量、结构性skip）×2种PTQ处理（复用原校准 vs 消融后重校准），仅当效应在6组合与3生成种子上同号且配对CI排除0，才记为「模块级归因」；否则标注为「量化/编译敏感性」，只入QLoRA语料、不入门控。多填充一致性从事后检查升为准入条件。

C2（对照臂，接受为决定性设计）：预注册A/B——A用归因轨迹，B仅用s_mobile，共享cycle-0、匹配候选数、设备预算与生成种子。主判据为 (A_c3−A_c0)−(B_c3−B_c0) 的配对CI，参考冻结于cycle-0。若A不显著优于B，我事先接受把贡献降格为「部署筛选启发式」，不称反事实因果NAS。

C3（度量修复）：删除比值c_m与ε。改词典序：先要求精度侧配对度量（与未消融模型的top-1一致率、ΔNLL，2000图主机INT8测量）CI排除0，再按Δt_best排序。s_mobile改为无量纲 a_int8/(t_best/t_ref^{c0})；后端预注册固定单一NNAPI，CPU/GPU仅作诊断，消除「三后端取最小中位数」的多重比较偏差。

C4（选择后推断，零额外设备成本）：缓存全部消融模型logits，自举时在每个重抽样内重跑完整选择流程（散度预筛+top-3正效应挑选），另留500图从未参与选择的确认集用于最终CI。Phase-0判据改为绝对量：MDE 0.8pp、一致率CI宽度≤1.5pp、deploy成功≥90%，取消可被基线噪声放宽的「≤2×SE」。

C5（预算闭合与残余弱点）：消融限cycle 1/3/5、每模型≤4模块。设备评估：A臂72基线+3×(5×4×2)=120，B臂72，计264（种子42全设备计时）；种子43/44仅测cycle 0/3端点 2×2×12=48，计96；CIFAR-10检查点24；合计约384≤480。诚实局限：仅一条轨迹有完整设备计时，43/44依赖Phase-0验证的延迟代理（30模型Spearman≥0.9）；代理不达标则A/B退化为n=1探索性结果，我不宣称统计显著的因果结论。
evidence: 基线的反向组合可分辨前提：CIFAR-10有增益、CIFAR-100不超未适配基线、而GPU精度仍上升。「GPU升/移动降」是代理错配的直接signature，搜索不足只会表现为两者同时停滞；A/B双臂加差中差是分离这两种解释的最小设计，也回应了「提升可能来自反复设备筛选或QLoRA」的替代解释。
方差量级可先验算清：512图CIFAR-100约每类5图，p≈0.5时准确率SE≈2.2pp，而单个macro-module的INT8效应常在0.3–1pp，故原Δa_int8门控在数学上不可能稳定。改用配对top-1一致率/ΔNLL并在主机2000图上测量，配对方差可低约一个量级；Phase-0的20模块自举正好能直接比较两种度量的绝对CI宽度，构成低成本预验证。
选择后推断可在不增加设备预算的前提下修正：消融模型的logits一次导出即可离线缓存，因此自举内重跑「散度预筛+top-3挑选」只消耗CPU；再叠加从未参与选择的500图确认集，把怀疑方指出的偏乐观CI换成可预注册的选择感知CI。这也是为何我接受取消相对阈值、改用绝对MDE与CI宽度。
预算口径按怀疑方最严格定义仍可闭合：把「一次评估」定义为单后端20次运行的中位数，并预注册只用NNAPI，即把设备墙钟压缩约3倍；再限消融于1/3/5周期、每模型≤4模块，得264+96+24≈384≤480。这比原方案「低产周期跳过消融」更可预注册，避免跳过策略与cycle-3 falsifier互相混淆。

turns.claim: 修订仍未闭合。最大矛盾是C1要求每模块3种填充×2种PTQ处理，但C5预算按×2计算；仅A臂消融即3×5×4×6=360次，而非120次，总量至少624，已超480且尚未计重复导出失败。其次，A/B只有种子42完整设备轨迹，43/44依赖延迟代理，不能形成匹配的三轨迹差中差；模型间Spearman≥0.9也不保证干预内Δ延迟排序或无系统偏差，因此统计因果结论实质仍是n=1。第三，“GPU升/移动降”并非代理错配的直接证据，也可由PTQ校准漂移、导出器回归、后端热状态或搜索方差产生；A/B只隔离归因语料的增量效果，不能识别这些机制。第四，top-1一致率不是性能效应：有害消融也可能与原模型高度一致，ΔNLL又依赖校准；要求18个填充×PTQ×种子组合全部同号会把估计目标变成极端稳健性筛选，并产生低功效和选择性存活。固定2000图选择集跨周期反馈还会导致自适应测试集过拟合，500图确认集不足以支持反复候选筛选。决定性方案是：先按完整6组合重算预算；至少3条A/B轨迹均做真实NNAPI测量；保留直到cycle 3才解封的独立测试集；加入随机模块标签、等参数结构替换和PTQ-only sham。只有A相对B在独立测试集显著提升，且真实模块效应超过三类sham并跨重校准复现，才支持模块归因；否则只能称部署敏感性筛选。
evidence: 预算算术错误：3周期×5模型×4模块×3填充×2 PTQ=360次消融；加A/B基线144、代理种子96及CIFAR-10约24，共约624次。
跨模型延迟代理相关性不能验证干预差值：即使总体Spearman很高，毫秒级模块效应仍可能被设备、融合和量化产生的局部误差反转。
GPU精度与移动分数反向变化不唯一识别代理错配；PTQ、编译器、热节流和后端选择均能产生同样观测。
跨周期用同一选择集生成QLoRA反馈属于自适应复用；普通留出CI即使重跑选择流程，也不能纠正训练过程对该集的逐轮过拟合。

turns.claim:
接受怀疑方四点（预算算术、n=1、机制不唯一识别、一致率非性能量），并以可预注册重构保留可检验内核。

R1 预算（全盘接受）：3填充×2 PTQ 下 A 臂消融确为 3×5×4×6=360、总约 624，超 480。重构：K=12→8、周期 6→4、消融限 cycle 1/2、每模型≤3 模块；并把 a_int8 全部移到主机 INT8 解释器测量（Phase-0 要求主机-设备 top-1 一致率≥99.5%，否则回退纯设备并公布退化方案），设备只测 t_best——延迟与图像数无关，设备成本=二进制数量。计数：cycle-0 三种子×8=24；cycle 1–3 三种子×2 臂×8×3=144；消融走「筛选-确认」两段，全部模块先在主机做精度侧筛选（零设备成本），仅通过者导出上机，含 sham 上限 120。合计≤288≤480，余量留作热漂移重测。

R2 三轨迹（接受）：取消延迟代理，seed 42/43/44 全部真实 NNAPI 测量，上述预算已按三种子计。诚实让步：n=3 无法给出总体显著性，主判据预注册为「3/3 种子方向一致且每种子封存集配对 CI 排除 0」；达不到即按事先承诺降级为部署筛选启发式，不称反事实因果 NAS。

R3 估计量与功效（部分让步）：撤回 top-1 一致率作主量（有害消融确可高度一致），仅留作诊断；撤回 18 组合同号（低功效、选择性存活）。主量改为封存集上的配对 Δa_int8（McNemar 型配对推断）；稳健性改为对 3 填充×2 PTQ 的随机效应合并，要求合并 95%CI 排除 0、≥5/6 同号并报告 I²；筛选段 α=0.10 单侧。

R4 自适应过拟合与机制（接受）：CIFAR-100 测试集三分——3000 选择集（承认自适应，仅供门控与 QLoRA）、3000 封存集（cycle 3 一次性解封，只用于 A/B 差中差）、2000 Phase-0 标定。加三类 sham：随机模块标签、等参数结构替换、PTQ-only 重校准；冻结导出器版本哈希、固定冷却与交错参考二进制以界定热漂移。撤回「GPU 升/移动降=代理错配」的识别性主张，仅作动机；A/B 识别归因语料增量效应，机制归因由 sham 差值承担。
evidence: 怀疑方引用的 2.2pp 是非配对 SE，不适用于同一模型消融前后的配对比较：配对二元检验的 SE≈√(b+c)/n，若不一致对占 6%、n=2000，则 SE≈0.55pp，足以支撑 0.8pp 的预注册 MDE。Phase-0 的 20 模块试点直接测量真实 b+c，从而在主campaign前证伪或证实这一功效前提。
设备预算能闭合的关键是延迟与图像数无关：a_int8 移至主机后，设备评估数=二进制数（NNAPI 单后端 20 次中位数）。168 基线 + ≤120 消融/sham = ≤288≤480；且 6 组合确认只对主机筛选幸存模块执行，把最坏情形 360 降为按幸存率线性缩放的开销。
「筛选-确认」两段设计在保留跨填充/跨校准稳健性的同时避免一致性要求导致的功效坍塌：随机效应合并给出可解释的干预族平均效应与异质性 I²，而 18 组合全同号在效应 0.5–1pp 量级下功效不足 0.2，会系统性地只留下异常大的伪效应。
封存集加三类 sham 使机制主张可证伪：真实模块效应须同时超过随机标签、等参数替换与 PTQ-only 重校准三条 sham 分布，否则按预注册规则降级为「量化/编译敏感性筛选」。这一判据不依赖对 cycle-0 反向现象的因果解读，因而不受 PTQ 漂移、导出器回归与热节流等替代机制污染。

turns.claim: 重构仍不足以支持“移动端模块归因”。核心缺口是把a_int8移到主机：主机—设备总体预测一致率≥99.5%并不保证不足1pp的消融差值同向；少量分歧若集中在受干预样本，主机Δa可为正而NNAPI Δa为负，因此新s_mobile并非实际移动端准确率/延迟。其次，≤120个消融/sham设备上限依赖未预注册的筛选幸存率；若候选超过上限，截断规则会引入赢家偏差，若不截断则最坏预算仍未闭合，且三类sham如何分配120次没有算术说明。第三，每种子在同一3000图封存集上的McNemar CI只刻画图像抽样误差，不包含架构生成、训练、PTQ及“取最佳候选”的方差；要求3/3 CI排除0不能替代独立轨迹层推断，且反复比较A/B、模块和sham仍需多重性控制。最后，6个高度相关的填充×PTQ效应用随机效应和I²并不可靠，PTQ处理仅两层且共享权重与样本，独立性假设不成立。决定性测试是：预注册最坏情形二进制清单及超限截断；对所有cycle-3 A/B最终候选在封存集直接运行NNAPI准确率；按生成种子和候选配对随机分配归因/纯s_mobile训练，至少5条完整轨迹；用轨迹级置换或层级模型检验A−B，并让真实模块与等预算、等语料剂量的三类sham竞争。否则结果最多证明主机筛选与设备延迟结合的启发式有效。
evidence: 99.5%总体一致率允许3000图中15个预测不同，已相当于0.5pp；若差异集中于消融翻转样本，足以反转0.8pp目标效应。
设备预算中的120是结果依赖上限而非最坏情形：筛选幸存模块数、每模块6种确认及三类sham的二进制数均未给出确定分配。
图像级配对CI无法覆盖仅3个生成种子的训练与搜索方差；同一封存图像上的多个模型也不是独立重复。
仅6个相关干预条件估计随机效应方差和I²极不稳定；共享模型、校准集和样本违反简单随机效应分析的独立性。

debate.consensus: Both sides converged on a substantially narrowed but genuinely testable program. Agreed: (1) the original per-module causal claim is retracted; the confirmatory object is now the incremental effect of an attribution-labeled QLoRA corpus on mobile deployability, tested by a paired A/B loop where the only difference between arms is corpus labeling, with dose-matched corpora. (2) The ratio metric c_m and its epsilon are dropped; screening and confirmation are separated, with a single pre-registered confirmatory filler condition and the remaining filler x PTQ conditions reported descriptively rather than pooled under a random-effects model whose independence assumption both sides agree is violated. (3) Any accuracy quantity that enters a confirmatory claim must be measured on-device under the single pre-registered NNAPI backend; host INT8 is demoted to a zero-device-cost screening stage at alpha=0.10 with no inferential weight, precisely because overall host-device agreement of 99.5% cannot bound sub-1pp effects concentrated on intervened samples. (4) Image-level paired CIs do not cover generation, training, PTQ, and best-candidate-selection variance, so the primary endpoint is a trajectory-level exact paired permutation test over five complete seeds, each with real device timing; the latency proxy is abandoned. (5) The device budget must be a pre-registered worst-case binary manifest with a deterministic truncation and spill order, not an outcome-dependent cap: the reconstructed manifest is 210 baseline latency binaries, 180 attribution and sham confirmation binaries, 15 sequestered accuracy runs, and 40 Phase-0 binaries, totaling <=445 against the 480 cap. (6) Mechanism claims rest on three equal-budget shams (random module label, iso-parameter structural substitution, PTQ-only recalibration) rather than on the cycle-0 'GPU up / mobile down' observation, whose identifying power the advocate withdrew. (7) A binding downgrade rule is pre-registered: if the trajectory-level test or the sham margins fail, the contribution is reported as a deployment-screening heuristic, not counterfactual causal NAS. Under these terms the program is falsifiable at every stage (Phase-0 go/no-go, cycle-3 primary endpoint, sham margins), the GPU cost of roughly 150 H100-hours sits far inside 8xH100x7 days, and the binding constraint (single tablet wall clock) is closed by moving accuracy off-device for screening while keeping all confirmatory accuracy on-device. The residual disagreement is about ambition, not validity: the skeptic is right that what survives is a modest, largely negative-capable result, and the moderator judges that acceptable because the pre-registered negative outcomes (Phase-0 infrastructure failure, null A-B difference, sham-indistinguishable module effects) are themselves informative and cheap.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether host-device INT8 agreement holds conditional on ablation-flipped samples rather than in aggregate; Phase-0 measures this directly, but a failure forces all accuracy on-device and shrinks the sequestered subset, reducing power below the 0.8pp MDE.

Power at five trajectories: the exact paired permutation test reaches one-sided alpha=0.05 only under 5/5 sign agreement, so a real but moderate corpus effect (for example 3/5 or 4/5 seeds favoring the attribution arm) yields an uninterpretable result rather than evidence of absence.

Whether three improvement cycles are enough for a corpus-labeling difference to propagate through QLoRA into generated architectures at all; the original stall was observed over six cycles, and cycle count was traded away for seed count.

Whether macro-module INT8 effects of >=0.8pp exist in LLM-generated LEMUR graphs; if true effects sit at 0.2-0.5pp, the whole attribution layer is under-powered by construction and only the deployment-screening result remains.

Whether an observed A-B gap, if any, is attributable to attribution content rather than to residual corpus-composition differences that dose-matching does not fully equalize (label entropy, trace length, motif coverage).

External validity beyond one SM-P613, one NNAPI backend, one exporter hash, and CIFAR-100: thermal and compiler idiosyncrasies are controlled but not generalized, and CIFAR-10 checkpoints are too sparse to establish transfer.

Whether the deterministic truncation and spill order fully removes winner's bias in practice when export failures cluster on a particular macro-type, which would non-randomly deplete one intervention family.

finalIdea.title: Device-Confirmed Module Attribution as a Corpus Signal for Mobile-Native LLM Architecture Generation
finalIdea.hypothesis: If a pre-registered Phase-0 pilot passes all four gates (compile-time ablatable yield >=60% and deploy-export success >=90% on 50 LLM-generated LEMUR graphs; measured discordant-pair count b+c on 20 real module ablations implying a paired on-device McNemar MDE <=0.8pp at n=3000; host-vs-device INT8 agreement >=99% restricted to ablation-flipped samples, not aggregate; and thermal drift of an interleaved reference binary <=2% of its median NNAPI latency), then across five paired generation seeds a closed loop whose QLoRA corpus is labeled with device-confirmed, sham-surviving module attributions (arm A) will achieve a larger cycle-3-minus-cycle-0 gain in sequestered s_mobile than a dose-matched loop gated on s_mobile alone (arm B), under an exact paired permutation test over seeds at one-sided alpha=0.05; and the confirmed module effects will exceed all three equal-budget sham families. If either the trajectory-level test or the sham margins fail, the pre-registered conclusion is that host-side screening plus device latency gating is a useful deployment-screening heuristic and that module-level counterfactual attribution provides no additional signal.
finalIdea.motivation: The mobile-deployment closed loop gains on CIFAR-10 but never beats an unadapted CIFAR-100 baseline while GPU accuracy keeps rising, suggesting the generator is rewarded for a proxy that does not survive INT8 deployment. Counterfactual-audit work shows aggregate metrics can hide content-specific shifts detectable only through dense, calibrated interventions, and SeDeM motivates decoupling compact generation from target-conditioned selection. Three rounds of adversarial review reshaped this intuition into something testable. Round 1 showed a full dense ablation grid exceeds tablet wall clock and that 256-image holdouts cannot stabilize per-module bootstrap CIs. Round 2 exposed metric conflation between the deployability gate and the attribution score, an undercounted device budget, and unbuilt ablation infrastructure. Round 3 established the two decisive constraints that shape this version: the 'GPU up / mobile down' pattern does not uniquely identify proxy misalignment (PTQ calibration drift, exporter regressions, thermal throttling, and search variance all produce it), so mechanism claims must be carried by shams rather than by that observation; and image-level paired inference on a single trajectory cannot substitute for trajectory-level inference, so the design must fund five complete seeds with real NNAPI measurement rather than three seeds plus a latency proxy. The remaining question is deliberately modest and answerable within budget: does labeling a deployment-aware finetuning corpus with device-confirmed module attributions buy anything over gating on the deployability score alone?
method: Phase 0 (days 1-2, pre-registered go/no-go, ~40 device binaries): extend TuneNNGen --mobile_deployment to emit four ablatable macro-types (conv block, depthwise separable, skip, head) with a compile-time validator; freeze filler semantics (conv: 1x1 identity, scale=1; depthwise: pointwise group=1 passthrough; skip: zero residual branch; head: uniform logit bias); on 50 generated graphs require ablatable yield >=60% and export success >=90%; on 20 real ablations of the cycle-0 CIFAR-100 baseline measure the discordant-pair count b+c on-device and require the implied McNemar MDE <=0.8pp at n=3000, host-vs-device agreement >=99% computed only over ablation-flipped samples, and reference-binary thermal drift <=2%. Publish the worst-case device binary manifest, the deterministic truncation rule, and the spill order before any main-campaign run; any gate failure stops the campaign and is reported as a negative infrastructure result.

Data partition, fixed before cycle 0: CIFAR-100 test split into 2000 Phase-0 calibration images, 3000 selection images (openly adaptive; used for gating, host screening, and QLoRA curation, with no confirmatory claims), 3000 sequestered images (device-measured, unsealed exactly once after cycle 3 for the primary endpoint), and 2000 untouched reserve.

Paired A/B loop: 5 generation seeds (42-46) x 2 arms x cycles 0-3, K=6 candidates per cycle. Arms share the cycle-0 population, generation seeds, candidate counts, device budget, and QLoRA hyperparameters and corpus size; they differ only in corpus labeling (arm A: device-confirmed attribution traces plus demotion traces for modules with positive GPU delta-acc and negative on-device delta-a_int8; arm B: s_mobile-ranked traces only, token-count and trace-count matched).

Deployability metric: s_mobile = a_int8 / (t_best / t_ref_c0), dimensionless against the frozen cycle-0 reference latency. t_best is the median of 20 runs on a single pre-registered backend (NNAPI); CPU and GPU delegates are recorded as diagnostics only and never enter a gate, eliminating min-over-backends selection bias. Exporter version hash, calibration set, cooldown interval, and an interleaved reference binary are frozen for the whole campaign.

Screening stage (zero device cost): for the top-3 GPU/INT8-divergent candidates per cycle, ablate up to 3 modules each on the host INT8 interpreter over the 3000-image selection set at one-sided alpha=0.10; rank survivors by screen statistic and pass a fixed, pre-registered number (6 module interventions per seed per cycle, at cycles 1 and 2 only) to device confirmation regardless of effect magnitude, so the truncation is deterministic rather than outcome-adaptive.

Confirmation stage (device): each passed intervention is exported as an ablated binary plus its type-matched primary filler binary and measured on-device; the confirmatory statistic is the paired McNemar test on delta-a_int8 versus filler. The two remaining filler variants and the ablation-recalibrated PTQ variant are reported as descriptive sign-consistency, never pooled via random-effects or I-squared, since the six conditions share weights, calibration set, and images.

Sham controls with matched budget and matched corpus dose: (i) random module labels, (ii) iso-parameter structural substitution, (iii) PTQ-only recalibration with no structural change. One sham intervention per family per seed per cycle is confirmed on-device. A module is called attributed only if its confirmed effect exceeds the maximum of the three sham distributions at the pre-registered margin; otherwise it is labeled quantization/compile sensitivity and may enter the corpus but never a gate.

Cycle gate: accept augmentation only if the best candidate reaches s_mobile >= 0.99 x s_ref on the selection set; rank on s_mobile, break ties with the count of sham-surviving attributed modules. GPU accuracy never gates.
QLoRA-finetune ABrain/NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag for 3 epochs per arm per cycle on the previous cycle's corpus, with arm-specific labeling as defined above.

Primary analysis: unseal the sequestered set once; compute per-seed (A_cycle3 - A_cycle0) - (B_cycle3 - B_cycle0) in device-measured s_mobile and test with an exact paired permutation over the 5 seeds (one-sided alpha=0.05, which requires 5/5 sign agreement). Module and sham family comparisons use Holm correction within their families and are secondary. The pre-registered downgrade rule applies verbatim if the primary test fails.

Falsifiers: primary, the permutation test on the A-B difference-in-differences is non-significant; secondary, confirmed module effects do not exceed sham maxima; tertiary, Phase-0 gate failure. Diagnostics reported regardless: Spearman(GPU epoch-1 accuracy, s_mobile) per cycle (descriptive, explicitly non-identifying), ablation-valid fraction, deploy success with 95% CI, and the reconciled device manifest.
evaluation: Primary endpoint: trajectory-level paired difference-in-differences of device-measured sequestered s_mobile between the attribution-labeled arm and the s_mobile-only arm across 5 seeds, exact permutation test, one-sided alpha=0.05.

Attribution validity: fraction of device-confirmed modules whose paired McNemar delta-a_int8 versus type-matched filler is significant after Holm correction, and the margin by which their effect distribution exceeds each of the three sham families.

Robustness (descriptive, not inferential): sign agreement of each confirmed module effect across the two secondary fillers and the ablation-recalibrated PTQ condition, reported as raw counts with per-condition CIs and no pooling.

Measurement validity: host-vs-device INT8 agreement restricted to ablation-flipped samples, reference-binary thermal drift over the campaign, and export-failure counts by macro-type (to detect non-random depletion of an intervention family).

Divergence diagnostic: per-cycle Spearman(GPU epoch-1 accuracy, s_mobile), reported as motivation-level context only, with the explicit statement that it does not identify proxy misalignment against PTQ drift, exporter regression, or thermal alternatives.

Efficiency and budget reconciliation: realized device binaries against the pre-registered worst-case manifest (210 baseline latency + 180 attribution/sham confirmation + 15 sequestered accuracy + 40 Phase-0 = 445 of a 480 cap), plus the invoked spill order if any.

Ablations: (i) screening stage without device confirmation, (ii) device gating without any attribution labeling (this is arm B), (iii) 1500- vs 3000-image sequestered set for effect stability, (iv) GPU-threshold prefilter retained vs removed.
finalIdea.expectedContribution: A pre-registered, budget-closed test of whether module-level counterfactual attribution adds anything beyond deployability gating in LLM-driven mobile NAS, delivered with the measurement scaffolding the debate showed to be missing: compile-time ablation validation with frozen type-matched fillers, a strict separation between zero-cost host screening and device-confirmed inference, three equal-budget sham families that carry the mechanism claim, trajectory-level rather than image-level inference over five complete seeds, and a binding downgrade rule that reports the result as a deployment-screening heuristic when the causal reading is unsupported. Every terminal state (Phase-0 infrastructure failure, null corpus effect, sham-indistinguishable modules, or a positive attribution effect) is informative and pre-committed.
finalIdea.impactAssessment: A positive result would give deployment-aware LLM finetuning a concrete, auditable corpus signal and would show that hard mobile tasks stall on proxy misalignment rather than insufficient search. A null result is nearly as useful and is the more likely outcome: it would bound the value of module-level counterfactual probing under INT8 quantization noise and redirect effort toward quantization-aware generation or better deployability proxies. The Phase-0 gates alone produce a reusable, publishable measurement result about whether sub-1pp macro-module effects are resolvable at all on commodity mobile hardware. Impact is real but bounded by single-device, single-backend, single-dataset scope.
finalIdea.noveltyAssessment: The novelty is no longer the causal-attribution claim, which was retracted during review, but the combination of a paired dose-matched A/B over generation trajectories, host-screen/device-confirm separation for quantized counterfactuals, and three equal-budget sham families applied to CNN macro-modules inside a closed LLM architecture-generation loop. No prior work tests whether attribution labeling of a NAS finetuning corpus has incremental value against a matched control arm; existing counterfactual-audit work targets KV blocks and long-context memory rather than exported INT8 mobile graphs. This is a solid methodological contribution rather than a conceptual breakthrough.
finalIdea.resourceAssessment: GPU: Phase-0 validator sweep and bootstrap pilot ~20 H100-hours; 210 one-epoch CIFAR-100 candidate trainings (30 at cycle 0 plus 5 seeds x 2 arms x 3 cycles x 6 candidates) ~20-50 H100-hours; 30 QLoRA runs (5 seeds x 2 arms x 3 cycles, 3 epochs each) ~60-90 H100-hours. Total ~150 H100-hours against 1344 available under 8xH100 for 7 days, leaving room for reruns; candidate trainings and QLoRA runs parallelize across the 8 GPUs. Device: one SM-P613, worst-case 445 binaries at ~2.5 minutes each including load and cooldown (~19 hours) plus 15 sequestered accuracy passes over 3000 images (~2 hours), scriptable overnight across days 3-6 with 35 binaries of slack and a pre-registered spill order (drop the iso-parameter sham at cycle 2 first, then cycle-2 attribution confirmations) if export retries consume it. Schedule: days 1-2 Phase 0, days 3-6 cycles, day 7 unsealing and analysis. The campaign is device-wall-clock-bound, not GPU-bound, which is why all screening accuracy was moved to the host.
finalIdea.trainingResources: Phase 0: 1 H100 for the TuneNNGen/LEMUR extension, 50-graph validator sweep, and 20-module device pilot. Main campaign: up to 4 H100s for parallel 1-epoch CIFAR-100 candidate training, 2 H100s for QLoRA (3 epochs x 30 arm-cycles), one Android SM-P613 for all confirmatory latency and sequestered accuracy (<=445 binaries against a 480 cap, reconciled against the pre-registered manifest), and a Linux workstation for PTQ, TFLite export, host INT8 screening, and compile-time ablation validation. No LLM pretraining.
risks: Phase-0 may fail any of its four gates, most plausibly the conditional host-device agreement or the 0.8pp MDE, stopping the campaign before cycle 1 and leaving only a negative infrastructure result.
At five seeds the exact permutation test needs unanimous sign agreement, so a genuine but moderate corpus effect will land in an uninterpretable middle zone rather than being detected.
Compressing to three improvement cycles (from six) to fund five seeds may not leave enough loop iterations for a corpus-labeling difference to change generated architectures at all.
True macro-module INT8 effects may sit below 0.5pp, in which case the attribution layer is under-powered by construction regardless of measurement quality.

Frozen filler semantics may not be uniquely realizable on some generated LEMUR graphs, and export failures clustering on one macro-type would non-randomly deplete an intervention family despite the deterministic truncation rule.
Dose-matching the two QLoRA corpora equalizes size and format but not label entropy or motif coverage, leaving a residual confound if arm A wins.
All confirmatory measurement comes from one tablet, one NNAPI backend, and one exporter hash; thermal and compiler idiosyncrasies are controlled within the campaign but not shown to generalize.
Device wall clock has only 35 binaries of slack; a hardware fault or a systematic export regression would trigger the spill order and reduce sham coverage at cycle 2.
